What and why

The page in docs/ loads Python (Pyodide, python-pptx and the deckfill package) from its own folder. It then adds a second Content Security Policy that blocks fetch, XHR, beacons, image requests and new workers. From then on, the user's template, outline and deck stay in the tab.

The deckfill package does the work in three calls the page makes one at a time: - read: check the template's size and package graph, then sort its layouts into title, content, two, section and other - plan: turn the outline into slides, choose a layout for each, and split slides the fit estimate says are too full - fill: remove the template's sample slides, add the planned slides into the layouts' own boxes, copy footers the template shows, and put the template's own bytes back for every part the fill did not mean to change

The same package runs under CPython in the tests, and the browser's download is byte for byte the CPython output (C10).

Requirements

  • D1: static site in docs/, Python through self-hosted Pyodide on the main thread, one deckfill module with read_template, parse_outline, plan_deck, fill
  • D1b (rev 5): the template is untrusted: 100 MB file, 2,000 members, 150 MB uncompressed, 30 MB XML, 5 MB per XML part, 100:1 ratio, caps enforced on bytes actually read; safe XML parsing; the seat may lower a cap to meet C12
  • D3: layouts classed by type and placeholders, never by name; a slide may only use a layout with a destination for every need
  • D4: sample slides removed with everything only they reach; every other part kept; footers follow what the template already shows; no text outside a placeholder
  • D5: split, warned or marked 'check this slide' by a fit estimate
  • D6: no request to another origin; at ready the page locks the network off, and Python's fetches are covered
  • D8: Cantonese copy in one file; mentron.hk look; phone view explains and hands over the link

Design

Three layers. The page (docs/app.js) owns the UI, the loading and the lockdown. It calls a small Python bridge (deckfill.web.Session) that turns each step into JSON. The deckfill package reads, plans and fills. Python runs on the main thread, because GitHub Pages cannot give a worker its own policy and a worker made from a URL does not inherit the page's lockdown. The page paints a working state and yields before every Python call, and the D1b caps bound the longest call.

sequenceDiagram participant U as User participant P as Page (app.js) participant Y as Pyodide + deckfill P->>Y: load runtime, wheels, deckfill.zip, fonts (own origin only) P->>P: add lockdown policy, status ready U->>P: drop template P->>Y: Session.read(bytes, name) Y-->>P: layouts and classes (JSON) U->>P: paste outline, change a layout P->>Y: Session.plan(text, overrides) Y-->>P: slides, fit status, warnings (JSON) U->>P: download P->>Y: Session.fill() Y-->>P: .pptx bytes P-->>U: blob download, no request

Decisions

Kept parts go back as the template's own bytes when their meaning is unchanged
G0 showed python-pptx re-sorting relationships and relativising absolute targets on every real template (EDB, elderly.gov.hk, Microsoft, USC), which C3 flagged; fixtures made by python-pptx never showed it
The restore step compares libxml2 serialisations, not C14N 2.0
C14N 2.0 in lxml is pure Python: a 5.6 s main-thread task on the elderly.gov.hk template against C12's 3 s bar; now 1.55 s
Lockdown is a second CSP meta added at ready
D6; measured in Chromium: after it, fetch from JS and Python and new workers are blocked and the server sees nothing (qa/e2e/c9-report.json)

Everything is new in this build. Changed in fix round 1: the boot order (prompt before engine), the stale-plan guard around download, and the engine checks marked in steps 2 to 4. Changed in the layout-override fix: a pick is placed on its slide by title, kind and nth (step 6). Boxes link to the steps below.

Implementation

1Boot: the prompt first, then the engine, then the lockdown

boot loads prompt.txt and checks the HTTP status before anything else; a failure sets the retry state and stops, and retry runs boot again, so Copy is never enabled with no prompt behind it (loadPromptText docs/app.js:129-138). Only then does loadEngine load Pyodide, the wheels and deckfill.zip (zipped from src/deckfill by build_docs scripts/build_docs.py:1-25) from the page's own folder, import every module and append the lockdown policy (lockdown docs/app.js:113-118). The base policy is the first meta in the head (CSP docs/index.html:5-5); the only links out are three fixed anchors (anchors docs/index.html:15-16); at 760 px or less the page shows the explainer and the copy-link button and skips the engine (phone CSS docs/style.css:248-268). Fonts are self-hosted: build_fonts scripts/build_fonts.py:1-66 subsets Noto Serif TC to the glyphs the page's own strings use and Newsreader to Latin, and copies Mentron Serif. Every page string, the example outline included, sits in one copy file (copy docs/copy.js:1-126); the prompt text (prompt docs/prompt.txt:1-29) is the same text as PROMPT.md PROMPT.md:1-35 and the skill body (skill skill/ppt-outline/SKILL.md:1-34), checked by C14 tests/test_c14_copy.py:1-62; the README README.md:1-25 points to the page.

2Read: preflight, caps, XML by content type, integrity

Before zipfile builds anything, preflight walks the central directory from the raw bytes, ZIP64 included: over 2,000 records is too_big, a count that disagrees with the end record is bad_file. unzip then enforces the size caps on declared and actual bytes (unzip src/deckfill/package.py:118-130). load treats a part as XML by name or by content type (is_xml src/deckfill/package.py:226-228), holds every XML part to the XML caps and the safe parser (load src/deckfill/package.py:325-345), and check_integrity now resolves the package root's relationships too (root src/deckfill/package.py:304-311). The parser has entities, network, huge trees and DTD loading off, and any DOCTYPE is refused as bad_file (xmlsafe src/deckfill/xmlsafe.py:25-46). read_template then classes each layout from its type and placeholders, never its name: a typed layout keeps its class only when it has the boxes that class needs, otherwise the placeholder rules decide, and anything left is other (classify src/deckfill/template.py:293-318); each body box gets a fit model from its position, autofit and level styles, or none when the box is missing (measure_body src/deckfill/template.py:242-274). Failures are codes the page maps to Cantonese messages (errors src/deckfill/errors.py:1-22).

3Plan: every body estimated, subtitles included

parse_outline refuses text over the character cap as too_long, normalises line ends and a BOM, then reads the # deck title, ## slides and indented bullets into slides with line-numbered warnings (parse_outline src/deckfill/outline.py:63-145). plan_deck lists the compatible layouts per outline slide, takes the override when the slide fits it and the default otherwise (fallback src/deckfill/plan.py:218-247), and splits bodies by the fit estimate. A title slide whose subtitle goes into a content body (the no-title-layout fallback, or an override) now gets that body's estimate: warned when it overflows, check when the box is not modelled. The wrap estimate counts a long word's lines with one division instead of one subtraction per line (text_lines src/deckfill/plan.py:133-170).

4Fill: sample slides out, footers placed, template bytes back

remove_slides strips every element that used a relationship to a removed slide, in parts python-pptx parses and, now, in XML parts it keeps as bytes such as viewProps.xml. footers_for copies an example footer onto the new slide; when the new layout has no box of that type, _place_footer keeps the footer's own position, else its layout's or master's (place src/deckfill/fill.py:146-179). _restore_kept puts the template's own bytes back for every kept part whose meaning is unchanged, XML found by content type (restore src/deckfill/fill.py:268-304), and the output must pass the same integrity check as the input.

5Page state: no download from an older plan

Any change to the outline, a layout or the template calls staleNow: Download is disabled at once and the generation counter moves, so a plan that finishes for older input is dropped (staleNow docs/app.js:241-251, gen check docs/app.js:272-272). On click, download reads the outline and the overrides and Session.fill plans and fills from exactly those in one Python call (bridge src/deckfill/web.py:131-140), so even a click that lands mid-edit ships the text on screen.

6Layout picks follow their slide

A pick in the layout list is stored as the slide's title, kind and nth: which of the slides with that title and kind it is (remember docs/app.js:324-327). The bridge computes nth for every slide (nths src/deckfill/web.py:40-48). On every plan and every fill, place_overrides finds the nth slide with that title and kind in the outline it was given, so a slide added or removed above does not move the pick. A pick whose slide is gone, renamed or of another kind comes back as a layout_gone warning naming the old title. plan_deck itself drops a pick the slide no longer fits, uses the default and adds layout_dropped; it also drops an index past the end with a blank layout_gone, which the page cannot send. The reply lists only the picks still in use (kept src/deckfill/web.py:108-115), and the page replaces its own list with it, so a dropped pick's note shows once (page docs/app.js:282-282). Before this, picks were keyed by slide index: after an insert above, the picked layout landed on the slide now at that index with no message (qa/override-fix/page-before.txt).

7QA tooling: what each check proves

C9 runs one session through the real page on a local server (server tests/e2e/server.mjs:1-41): two fills, reset, a measured 30 s idle, probes, an offline fill, then all three link-outs, each answered 204 so the page stays; the report records the commit and sha256 of every input and download, and privacy_proof qa/e2e/privacy_proof.py:1-50 fails on any request after ready, idle under 30 s or a changed tree. 1+"""Builds every fixture template the test suite uses into fixtures/out/ (spec Testing Decisions).
2+
3+Run: .venv/bin/python fixtures/make_fixtures.py
4+All templates are made here from python-pptx's default template or from the 匯通物流 spike
5+template; none comes from the web.
6+"""
7+
8+from __future__ import annotations

10+import copy

25+from pptx.util import Emu, Inches, Pt

27+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
28+OUT = HERE / "out"
29+NS = {
30+ "a": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main",
31+ "p": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main",
32+ "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
33+ "p14": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main",
34+}
35+CT_PRES = b"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation.main+xml"
36+CT_TEMPLATE = b"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.template.main+xml"
37+
38+CHINESE_NAMES = [
39+ "標題投影片", "標題及內容", "章節標題", "兩欄內容", "比較", "只有標題",
40+ "空白", "含標題的內容", "含標題的圖片", "標題及直書文字", "直書標題及文字",
41+]

44+def q(name: str) -> str:
45+ p, local = name.split(":")
46+ return "{%s}%s" % (NS[p], local)
47+
48+
49+def save(prs, name: str) -> Path:
50+ path = OUT / name
51+ prs.save(path)
52+ return path
53+

55+def layout_named(prs, name: str):
56+ for master in prs.slide_masters:
57+ for lay in master.slide_layouts:
58+ if lay.name == name:
59+ return lay
60+ raise KeyError(name)
61+

63+def remove_layouts(prs, names) -> None:
64+ for name in names:
65+ lay = layout_named(prs, name)
66+ lay.slide_master.slide_layouts.remove(lay)

69+def ph_sp(el, ph_type=None, idx=None):
70+ for ph in el.iter(q("p:ph")):
71+ if ph_type is not None and ph.get("type", "obj") != ph_type:
72+ continue
73+ if idx is not None and ph.get("idx") != str(idx):
74+ continue
75+ return ph.getparent().getparent().getparent()
76+ return None
77+
78+
79+def set_xfrm(sp, x, y, cx, cy) -> None:
80+ sppr = sp.find(q("p:spPr"))
81+ for old in sppr.findall(q("a:xfrm")):
82+ sppr.remove(old)
83+ xfrm = etree.SubElement(sppr, q("a:xfrm"))
84+ sppr.insert(0, xfrm)
85+ etree.SubElement(xfrm, q("a:off"), x=str(x), y=str(y))
86+ etree.SubElement(xfrm, q("a:ext"), cx=str(cx), cy=str(cy))
87+
88+
89+def set_body_pr(sp, **attrs) -> None:
90+ tx = sp.find(q("p:txBody"))
91+ bp = tx.find(q("a:bodyPr"))
92+ for k, v in attrs.items():
93+ bp.set(k, str(v))
94+
95+
96+def set_level_spacing(sp, before_pts: int, after_pts: int) -> None:
97+ """Explicit level 1 and 2 paragraph spacing in the layout placeholder's list style."""
98+ tx = sp.find(q("p:txBody"))
99+ ls = tx.find(q("a:lstStyle"))
100+ for child in list(ls):
101+ ls.remove(child)
102+ for lvl in (1, 2):
103+ ppr = etree.SubElement(ls, q("a:lvl%dpPr" % lvl))
104+ for tag, pts in (("spcBef", before_pts), ("spcAft", after_pts)):
105+ s = etree.SubElement(ppr, q("a:" + tag))
106+ etree.SubElement(s, q("a:spcPts"), val=str(pts * 100))
107+
108+
109+def footer_sp_from_layout(layout, ph_type: str, text: str | None, field: str | None, new_id: int):
110+ """A slide footer placeholder the way PowerPoint writes one: the layout's placeholder with an
111+ empty spPr and new text."""
112+ src = ph_sp(layout._element, ph_type)
113+ sp = copy.deepcopy(src)
114+ sp.find(q("p:nvSpPr")).find(q("p:cNvPr")).set("id", str(new_id))
115+ sppr = sp.find(q("p:spPr"))
116+ for child in list(sppr):
117+ sppr.remove(child)
118+ tx = sp.find(q("p:txBody"))
119+ for p in tx.findall(q("a:p")):
120+ tx.remove(p)
121+ p = etree.SubElement(tx, q("a:p"))
122+ if field:
123+ fld = etree.SubElement(p, q("a:fld"), id="{B6F15528-21DE-4FAA-801E-634DDDAF4B2B}", type=field)
124+ etree.SubElement(fld, q("a:rPr"), lang="zh-HK")
125+ etree.SubElement(fld, q("a:t")).text = text or "‹#›"
126+ else:
127+ r = etree.SubElement(p, q("a:r"))
128+ etree.SubElement(r, q("a:rPr"), lang="zh-HK")
129+ etree.SubElement(r, q("a:t")).text = text
130+ return sp
131+
132+
133+def add_footers(slide, layout, footers: dict) -> None:
134+ tree = slide._element.find(q("p:cSld")).find(q("p:spTree"))
135+ next_id = 100
136+ for t, (text, field) in footers.items():
137+ tree.append(footer_sp_from_layout(layout, t, text, field, next_id))
138+ next_id += 1

141+def bullets_slide(prs, layout_name: str, title: str, lines):
142+ lay = layout_named(prs, layout_name)
143+ s = prs.slides.add_slide(lay)
144+ s.shapes.title.text = title
145+ body = [ph for ph in s.placeholders if ph.placeholder_format.idx != 0]
146+ if body and lines:
147+ tf = body[0].text_frame
148+ tf.text = lines[0]
149+ for line in lines[1:]:
150+ tf.add_paragraph().text = line
151+ return s

155+ b = io.BytesIO()
156+ Image.new("RGB", size, color).save(b, "PNG")
157+ b.seek(0)
158+ return b

161+def zip_edit(src: Path, dst: Path, edits: dict, add: dict | None = None) -> Path:
162+ """Copy a zip, replacing members by function or bytes, adding members."""
163+ with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(dst, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
164+ for info in zin.infolist():
165+ data = zin.read(info.filename)
166+ if info.filename in edits:
167+ e = edits[info.filename]
168+ data = e(data) if callable(e) else e
169+ if data is None:
170+ continue
171+ zout.writestr(info.filename, data)
172+ for name, data in (add or {}).items():
173+ zout.writestr(name, data)
174+ return dst

198+def make_custom() -> Path:
199+ prs = Presentation()
200+ for lay, name in zip(prs.slide_layouts, CHINESE_NAMES):
201+ el = lay._element
202+ el.attrib.pop("type", None)
203+ el.find(q("p:cSld")).set("name", name)
204+ two = prs.slide_layouts[3]._element
205+ tree = two.find(q("p:cSld")).find(q("p:spTree"))
206+ left, right = ph_sp(two, "obj", 1), ph_sp(two, "obj", 2)
207+ # right column wider than the left, so neither size nor XML order gives left-to-right
208+ set_xfrm(left, 457200, 1600200, 3657600, 4525963)
209+ set_xfrm(right, 4572000, 1600200, 4114800, 4525963)
210+ # right column first in XML order
211+ tree.remove(right)
212+ left.addprevious(right)
213+ return save(prs, "custom.pptx")

225+def second_master(src: Path, dst: Path, prefix: str = "B ") -> Path:
226+ """Duplicate master 1, its theme and its layouts as master 2 (zip level)."""
227+ with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
228+ parts = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
229+ layout_names = sorted(

231+ key=lambda n: int(re.search(r"(\d+)\.xml", n).group(1)),

233+ offset = len(layout_names)

235+ m2_rels = m1_rels

239+ m2_rels = m2_rels.replace("theme1.xml", "theme2.xml")
240+ parts["ppt/slideMasters/_rels/slideMaster2.xml.rels"] = m2_rels.encode()
241+ m2 = etree.fromstring(parts["ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml"])
242+ for lid in m2.iter(q("p:sldLayoutId")):
243+ lid.set("id", str(int(lid.get("id")) + 1000))
244+ parts["ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster2.xml"] = etree.tostring(m2, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)
245+ parts["ppt/theme/theme2.xml"] = parts["ppt/theme/theme1.xml"]
246+ ct_add = []

249+ el = etree.fromstring(parts[n])
250+ csld = el.find(q("p:cSld"))
251+ csld.set("name", prefix + (csld.get("name") or ""))
252+ parts[f"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{i + offset}.xml"] = etree.tostring(
253+ el, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True
254+ )
255+ rels = parts[f"ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/slideLayout{i}.xml.rels"].decode().replace("slideMaster1.xml", "slideMaster2.xml")
256+ parts[f"ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/slideLayout{i + offset}.xml.rels"] = rels.encode()
257+ ct_add.append(
258+ f'<Override PartName="/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{i + offset}.xml" '
259+ 'ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideLayout+xml"/>'
260+ )
261+ ct_add.append(
262+ '<Override PartName="/ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster2.xml" '
263+ 'ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideMaster+xml"/>'
264+ )
265+ ct_add.append(
266+ '<Override PartName="/ppt/theme/theme2.xml" '
267+ 'ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.theme+xml"/>'
268+ )
269+ ct = parts["[Content_Types].xml"].decode().replace("</Types>", "".join(ct_add) + "</Types>")
270+ parts["[Content_Types].xml"] = ct.encode()
271+ prels = parts["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode()
272+ prels = prels.replace(
273+ "</Relationships>",
274+ '<Relationship Id="rIdM2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideMaster" '
275+ 'Target="slideMasters/slideMaster2.xml"/></Relationships>',
276+ )
277+ parts["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = prels.encode()
278+ pres = etree.fromstring(parts["ppt/presentation.xml"])
279+ lst = pres.find(q("p:sldMasterIdLst"))
280+ new = etree.SubElement(lst, q("p:sldMasterId"))
281+ new.set("id", str(2147483648 + 5000))
282+ new.set(q("r:id"), "rIdM2")
283+ parts["ppt/presentation.xml"] = etree.tostring(pres, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)
284+ with zipfile.ZipFile(dst, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
285+ for n, d in parts.items():

520+def make_encrypted(src: Path) -> Path:
521+ from msoffcrypto.format.ooxml import OOXMLFile
522+
523+ out = io.BytesIO()
524+ with open(src, "rb") as f:
525+ OOXMLFile(f).encrypt("password", out)
526+ path = OUT / "encrypted.pptx"
527+ path.write_bytes(out.getvalue())
528+ return path

531+def make_legacy_ppt() -> Path:
532+ """OLE compound file header with a 'PowerPoint Document' stream name, renamed .pptx."""
533+ header = bytearray(512)
534+ header[0:8] = b"\xd0\xcf\x11\xe0\xa1\xb1\x1a\xe1"
535+ struct.pack_into("<HHH", header, 24, 0x3E, 3, 0xFFFE)
536+ entry = bytearray(128)
537+ name = "PowerPoint Document".encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
538+ entry[0 : len(name)] = name
539+ struct.pack_into("<H", entry, 64, len(name))
540+ entry[66] = 2
541+ path = OUT / "legacy.pptx"
542+ path.write_bytes(bytes(header) + bytes(entry) * 4 + bytes(4096))
543+ return path
544+

552+ '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>'
553+ '<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>'
554+ '<Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/>'
555+ "</Types>",
556+ )
557+ z.writestr(

559+ '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'
560+ '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/>'
561+ "</Relationships>",
562+ )
563+ z.writestr("word/document.xml", '<?xml version="1.0"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"/>')
564+ return path

567+def make_zip_bomb(src: Path) -> Path:
568+ """A valid template plus a 400 MB member of zeros (declared and actual)."""
569+ path = OUT / "zip-bomb.pptx"
570+ zip_edit(src, path, {})
571+ with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "a", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as z:
572+ with z.open("ppt/media/bomb.bin", "w", force_zip64=True) as f:
573+ chunk = bytes(1 << 20)
574+ for _ in range(400):
575+ f.write(chunk)
576+ return path

579+def make_lying_size(src: Path) -> Path:
580+ """A member whose central directory and local header say 1000 bytes; it holds 40 MB."""
581+ path = OUT / "lying-size.pptx"
582+ zip_edit(src, path, {})
583+ with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "a", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as z:
584+ z.writestr("ppt/media/liar.bin", bytes(40 << 20))
585+ data = bytearray(path.read_bytes())
586+ name = b"ppt/media/liar.bin"
587+ # local file header: signature, then uncompressed size at offset 22
588+ lh = data.find(b"PK\x03\x04" + b"\x14\x00")
589+ while lh != -1:
590+ nlen = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, lh + 26)[0]
591+ if bytes(data[lh + 30 : lh + 30 + nlen]) == name:
592+ struct.pack_into("<I", data, lh + 22, 1000)
593+ break
594+ lh = data.find(b"PK\x03\x04", lh + 4)
595+ cd = data.find(b"PK\x01\x02")
596+ while cd != -1:
597+ nlen = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, cd + 28)[0]
598+ if bytes(data[cd + 46 : cd + 46 + nlen]) == name:
599+ struct.pack_into("<I", data, cd + 24, 1000)
600+ break
601+ cd = data.find(b"PK\x01\x02", cd + 4)
602+ path.write_bytes(bytes(data))
603+ return path
604+

626+def make_rels_order(src: Path) -> Path:
627+ """Relationships the way PowerPoint often writes them: not in Id order, and absolute
628+ targets. python-pptx re-sorts and relativises them on save; real templates do this
629+ (G0: EDB, Microsoft, USC), python-pptx-made fixtures never do."""
630+
631+ def reverse(data: bytes) -> bytes:
632+ rels = re.findall(rb"<Relationship [^>]*/>", data)
633+ start, end = data.index(rels[0]), data.rindex(rels[-1]) + len(rels[-1])
634+ return data[:start] + b"".join(reversed(rels)) + data[end:]
635+
636+ def absolute(data: bytes) -> bytes:
637+ return reverse(data).replace(b'Target="../theme/', b'Target="/ppt/theme/')
638+
639+ with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
640+ names = z.namelist()
641+ edits = {
642+ n: (absolute if n.startswith("ppt/slideMasters/_rels/") else reverse)
643+ for n in names
644+ if n.startswith(("ppt/slideMasters/_rels/", "ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/")) and n.endswith(".rels")
645+ }
646+ return zip_edit(src, OUT / "rels-order.pptx", edits)
647+

653+ return path

710+def renamed_layout(src: Path, dst: Path, body=None) -> Path:
711+ """F2: slideLayout11 stored as slideLayout11.dat, its content type and every target updated."""
712+ old, new = "ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout11.xml", "ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout11.dat"
713+ with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
714+ parts = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
715+ out = {}
716+ for n, d in parts.items():
717+ if n == old:
718+ n, d = new, (body(d) if body else d)
719+ elif n == "ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/slideLayout11.xml.rels":
720+ n = "ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/slideLayout11.dat.rels"
721+ elif n.endswith(".rels"):
722+ d = d.replace(b"slideLayout11.xml", b"slideLayout11.dat")
723+ elif n == "[Content_Types].xml":
724+ d = d.replace(b'PartName="/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout11.xml"', b'PartName="/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout11.dat"')
725+ assert b"slideLayout11.dat" in d
726+ out[n] = d
727+ with zipfile.ZipFile(dst, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
728+ for n, d in out.items():
729+ z.writestr(n, d)
730+ return dst

732+
733+def make_xml_renamed(src: Path) -> list[Path]:
734+ def doctype(d: bytes) -> bytes:
735+ decl, _, rest = d.partition(b"?>")
736+ return decl + b'?><!DOCTYPE p:sldLayout [<!ENTITY e "x">]>' + rest
737+
738+ def big(d: bytes) -> bytes:
739+ rnd = random.Random(5)
740+ pad = "".join(rnd.choice("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789") for _ in range(6 * 1024 * 1024))

35+def _kept_parts(package, removed: set):
36+ """Parts reachable from the package root without passing through a removed slide."""
37+ seen, stack = set(), [package._rels]
38+ out = []
39+ while stack:
40+ rels = stack.pop()
41+ for rel in rels.values():
42+ if rel.is_external:
43+ continue
44+ part = rel.target_part
45+ if part in removed or id(part) in seen:
46+ continue
47+ seen.add(id(part))
48+ out.append(part)
49+ stack.append(part.rels)
50+ return out

53+def remove_slides(prs) -> None:
54+ pres_part = prs.part
55+ pres = pres_part._element
56+ removed = {rel.target_part for rel in pres_part.rels.values() if rel.reltype == RT_SLIDE}
57+ # presentation.xml: slide list, custom shows, section list
58+ sld_lst = pres.find(q("p:sldIdLst"))
59+ if sld_lst is not None:
60+ for sid in list(sld_lst):
61+ sld_lst.remove(sid)
62+ for cs in pres.findall(q("p:custShowLst")):
63+ pres.remove(cs)
64+ ext_lst = pres.find(q("p:extLst"))
65+ if ext_lst is not None:
66+ for ext in list(ext_lst):
67+ if ext.get("uri") == SECTION_EXT_URI or ext.find(q("p14:sectionLst")) is not None:
68+ ext_lst.remove(ext)
69+ if len(ext_lst) == 0:
70+ pres.remove(ext_lst)
71+ # every kept part, presentation.xml included: drop relationships to removed slides and the
72+ # elements that use them (layout or master hyperlinks to a slide, outline view lists)
73+ for part in [pres_part] + _kept_parts(prs.part.package, removed):
74+ rids = [rid for rid, rel in part.rels.items() if not rel.is_external and rel.target_part in removed]
75+ if not rids:
76+ continue
77+ dead = set(rids)
78+ el_root = getattr(part, "_element", None)
79+ if el_root is not None:
80+ _drop_dead_refs(el_root, dead)
81+ elif is_xml_type(part.content_type) or is_xml_name(str(part.partname)):
82+ # an XML part python-pptx keeps as bytes, such as viewProps.xml (Codex round 1, F6)
83+ root = parse(part.blob, str(part.partname))
84+ if _drop_dead_refs(root, dead):
85+ part._blob = etree.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)
86+ for rid in rids:
87+ part.rels.pop(rid)

90+def _drop_dead_refs(root, dead: set) -> bool:

94+ if any(v in dead for _, v in _r_attrs(el)):
95+ parent = el.getparent()
96+ if parent is not None:

112+ found = {}

121+def _layout_footer_sp(layout, t):

123+ if ph_type(ph) == t:
124+ return sp, ph
125+ return None, None

128+def _footer_from_layout(layout, t):
129+ """D4 step 3: the layout's own placeholder; a date only when it is a field."""

131+ if sp is None:

134+ if t == "dt" and (tx is None or tx.find(".//" + q("a:fld")) is None):

136+ if t == "ftr" and not _has_text(sp):

139+ sppr = new.find(q("p:spPr"))
140+ if sppr is not None:
141+ for child in list(sppr):

146+def _place_footer(el, el_ph, t: str, src_layout, master_el, new_layout) -> bool:
147+ """Give a copied footer an explicit place when the new layout cannot supply one. Uses the
148+ footer's own xfrm, else its source layout's or the master's box of the same type. Its idx moves
149+ off any idx the new layout already uses. False when no place is known."""
150+ sppr = el.find(q("p:spPr"))
151+ if sppr is None:
152+ return False
153+ if sppr.find(q("a:xfrm")) is None:
154+ donor = None
155+ for root in (src_layout._element, master_el):
156+ for sp, ph in placeholders(root):
157+ if ph_type(ph) == t:
158+ x = sp.find(q("p:spPr")).find(q("a:xfrm")) if sp.find(q("p:spPr")) is not None else None
159+ if x is not None:
160+ donor = x
161+ break
162+ if donor is not None:
163+ break
164+ if donor is None:
165+ return False
166+ sppr.insert(0, copy.deepcopy(donor))
167+ used = {ph_idx(ph) for _, ph in placeholders(new_layout._element)}
168+ idx = ph_idx(el_ph)
169+ if idx in used:
170+ el_ph.set("idx", str(max(used | {idx}) + 1))

227+def _put(ph_sp, paras):

232+ p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()

244+def _update_app_xml(prs, n: int) -> None:

257+def _number_slidenum_fields(el, number: int) -> None:

261+ for fld in el.iter(q("a:fld")):

268+def _restore_kept(inp: dict[str, bytes], out: dict[str, bytes], main: str) -> dict[str, bytes]:

307+ info, pkg = open_template(data, filename)

309+ if expected != plan:

311+ from pptx import Presentation

329+ shapes = {sh.placeholder_format.idx: sh for sh in slide.placeholders}

331+ if ps.dest.title is not None and ps.title:
332+ _put(shapes[ps.dest.title], [(1, ps.title)])
333+ keep.add(ps.dest.title)
334+ body_paras = {}

338+ for idx, items in zip(ps.dest.bodies, ps.columns):

346+ for idx, sp in by_idx.items():

349+ for el in footers_for(ps.layout, layout, li, inputs, masters[ps.layout]):
350+ el.find(q("p:nvSpPr")).find(q("p:cNvPr")).set("id", str(_next_shape_id(slide._element)))

356+ tree.append(el)

1+"""parse_outline: the D2 outline format into slides plus warnings for lines it could not place."""
2+
3+from __future__ import annotations
4+
5+import re
6+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
7+
8+from .errors import OutlineError
9+
10+MAX_CHARS = 50_000
11+
12+WS = " \t　"
13+_HEADING = re.compile(r"^(#+)(?:[ \t　]+(.*))?$")
14+# Bullet marks of D2. '-', '*' and '1.' / '1)' need a space after them, so '-5%' or '1.5 億'
15+# stay text; the CJK marks and dots do not.
16+_BULLET = re.compile(
17+ r"^(?:[-*](?:[ \t　]+|$)|[•·‧][ \t　]*|\d+[.)](?:[ \t　]+|$)|\d+、[ \t　]*"
18+ r"|[一二三四五六七八九十百零〇]+、[ \t　]*)"
19+)
20+_FENCE = re.compile(r"^(```|~~~)")
21+_CONTROL = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]")
22+
23+
24+@dataclass(frozen=True)
25+class Item:
26+ level: int # 1 or 2
27+ text: str
28+
29+
30+@dataclass(frozen=True)
31+class OutlineSlide:
32+ kind: str # title, content, two, section
33+ title: str
34+ subtitle: tuple[str, ...] = ()
35+ columns: tuple[tuple[Item, ...], ...] = ()
36+ line: int = 0
37+
38+
39+@dataclass(frozen=True)
40+class Warning:
41+ line: int
42+ code: str
43+ text: str
44+
45+
46+@dataclass(frozen=True)
47+class Outline:
48+ title: str
49+ slides: tuple[OutlineSlide, ...]
50+ warnings: tuple[Warning, ...]
51+
52+ def to_dict(self) -> dict:
53+ return asdict(self)
54+
55+
56+def _indent_level(raw: str) -> int:
57+ lead = raw[: len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip(WS))]
58+ if "\t" in lead or "　" in lead or lead.count(" ") >= 2:
59+ return 2
60+ return 1
61+
62+
63+def parse_outline(text: str) -> Outline:
64+ if len(text) > MAX_CHARS:
65+ raise OutlineError("too_long", f"{len(text)} characters")
66+ text = text.lstrip("﻿").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
67+ warnings: list[Warning] = []
68+ slides: list[dict] = []
69+ deck_title: str | None = None
70+ title_slide: dict | None = None
71+ cur: dict | None = None # current ## slide
72+
73+ def warn(line: int, code: str, txt: str) -> None:
74+ warnings.append(Warning(line, code, txt))
75+
76+ for n, raw in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1):
77+ raw = _CONTROL.sub("", raw).rstrip(WS + "\v\f")
78+ stripped = raw.strip(WS)
79+ if not stripped or _FENCE.match(stripped):
80+ continue
81+ m = _HEADING.match(stripped)
82+ plain = False
83+ if m and len(m.group(1)) >= 3 and (m.group(2) or "").strip(WS):
84+ # Not part of D2: read as a plain line so no text is lost.
85+ warn(n, "heading_level", stripped)
86+ stripped = m.group(2).strip(WS)
87+ plain = True
88+ elif m:
89+ hashes, body = m.group(1), (m.group(2) or "").strip(WS)
90+ if len(hashes) == 1 and deck_title is None and not slides:
91+ if not body:
92+ warn(n, "empty_heading", stripped)
93+ continue
94+ deck_title = body
95+ title_slide = {"kind": "title", "title": body, "subtitle": [], "line": n}
96+ continue
97+ if len(hashes) == 1:
98+ warn(n, "second_title", stripped)
99+ if not body:
100+ warn(n, "empty_heading", stripped)
101+ if len(hashes) >= 3:
102+ continue
103+ cur = {"title": body, "cols": [[], []], "col": 0, "split": False, "line": n}
104+ slides.append(cur)
105+ continue
106+ if stripped == "||":
107+ if cur is None:
108+ warn(n, "columns_outside_slide", stripped)
109+ elif cur["split"]:
110+ warn(n, "extra_columns", stripped)
111+ else:
112+ cur["split"] = True
113+ cur["col"] = 1
114+ continue
115+ level = _indent_level(raw)
116+ bm = None if plain else _BULLET.match(stripped)
117+ content = stripped[bm.end():].strip(WS) if bm else stripped
118+ if bm and not content:
119+ warn(n, "empty_bullet", stripped)
120+ continue
121+ if cur is not None:
122+ cur["cols"][cur["col"]].append(Item(level, content))
123+ elif title_slide is not None:
124+ title_slide["subtitle"].append(content)
125+ else:
126+ warn(n, "outside_slide", stripped)
127+
128+ out: list[OutlineSlide] = []
129+ if title_slide is not None:
130+ out.append(OutlineSlide("title", title_slide["title"], tuple(title_slide["subtitle"]), (), title_slide["line"]))
131+ for s in slides:
132+ left, right = tuple(s["cols"][0]), tuple(s["cols"][1])
133+ if s["split"]:
134+ out.append(OutlineSlide("two", s["title"], (), (left, right), s["line"]))
135+ elif left:
136+ out.append(OutlineSlide("content", s["title"], (), (left,), s["line"]))
137+ else:
138+ out.append(OutlineSlide("section", s["title"], (), (), s["line"]))
139+ if deck_title is None:
140+ if slides:
141+ deck_title = slides[0]["title"]
142+ warnings.insert(0, Warning(slides[0]["line"], "no_title", slides[0]["title"]))
143+ else:
144+ deck_title = ""
145+ return Outline(deck_title, tuple(out), tuple(sorted(warnings, key=lambda w: w.line)))

1+"""Load an untrusted .pptx/.potx: size caps (D1b), safe XML, integrity check (D4).

31+CT_TEMPLATE = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.template.main+xml"
32+CT_SHOW = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideshow.main+xml"
33+CT_PRES_MACRO = "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint.presentation.macroEnabled.main+xml"
34+MAIN_TYPES = {CT_PRES: "pptx", CT_TEMPLATE: "potx", CT_SHOW: "ppsx"}
35+RT_OFFICE_DOC = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument"

47+ def zip_bytes(self) -> bytes:
48+ """A clean zip python-pptx can open. A template's main content type is rewritten to a

51+ with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as z:
52+ for name, data in self.parts.items():

54+ data = data.replace(CT_TEMPLATE.encode(), CT_PRES.encode()).replace(
55+ CT_SHOW.encode(), CT_PRES.encode()
56+ )

62+ low = name.lower()

67+ return bool(ct) and (ct.endswith("+xml") or ct in ("application/xml", "text/xml"))

70+def sniff(data: bytes, filename: str) -> None:
71+ """Refuse what is plainly not a usable PowerPoint file before unzipping."""
72+ if len(data) > MAX_FILE:
73+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"{len(data)} bytes")
74+ if data[:8] == OLE_MAGIC:
75+ # Both old .ppt files and password-protected .pptx files are OLE compound files.
76+ # A protected file carries an EncryptedPackage stream.
77+ if ENCRYPTED_STREAM in data:
78+ raise TemplateError("encrypted")
79+ raise TemplateError("legacy_ppt")
80+ if data[:4] not in (b"PK\x03\x04", b"PK\x05\x06"):
81+ raise TemplateError("not_pptx")

83+
84+def preflight(data: bytes) -> int:
85+ """Count the central directory's records from the raw bytes, before zipfile builds an object
86+ per record (Codex round 1, F3). Refuses too_big past the member cap, bad_file when the end
87+ records and the directory disagree. Returns the record count."""
88+ pos = data.rfind(b"PK\x05\x06", max(0, len(data) - 22 - 0xFFFF))
89+ if pos < 0 or pos + 22 > len(data):
90+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", "no end of central directory")
91+ _, _, _, _, n_total, cd_size, cd_offset, _ = struct.unpack_from("<IHHHHIIH", data, pos)
92+ end = pos
93+ if n_total == 0xFFFF or cd_size == 0xFFFFFFFF or cd_offset == 0xFFFFFFFF:
94+ loc = pos - 20
95+ rec = loc - 56
96+ if rec < 0 or data[loc : loc + 4] != b"PK\x06\x07" or data[rec : rec + 4] != b"PK\x06\x06":
97+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", "zip64 end records missing")
98+ n_total, cd_size = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", data, rec + 32)
99+ end = rec
100+ if n_total > MAX_MEMBERS:
101+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"{n_total} members declared")
102+ if cd_size > end:
103+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", "central directory larger than the file")
104+ p, count = end - cd_size, 0
105+ while p < end:
106+ if count >= MAX_MEMBERS:
107+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"over {MAX_MEMBERS} members in the central directory")
108+ if data[p : p + 4] != b"PK\x01\x02" or p + 46 > end:
109+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", "damaged central directory")
110+ n, m, k = struct.unpack_from("<HHH", data, p + 28)
111+ p += 46 + n + m + k
112+ count += 1
113+ if count != n_total:
114+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", f"central directory has {count} records, end record says {n_total}")
115+ return count
116+
117+
118+def unzip(data: bytes) -> dict[str, bytes]:
119+ preflight(data)
120+ try:
121+ zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
122+ infos = zf.infolist()
123+ except (zipfile.BadZipFile, ValueError, OSError) as e:
124+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", f"zip: {e}") from e
125+ if len(infos) > MAX_MEMBERS:
126+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"{len(infos)} members")
127+ total = xml_total = 0
128+ for info in infos:
129+ if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
130+ raise TemplateError("encrypted", "zip member encrypted")
131+ total += info.file_size
132+ if is_xml_name(info.filename):
133+ xml_total += info.file_size
134+ if info.file_size > MAX_XML_PART:
135+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"xml part {info.filename}")
136+ if info.file_size and (info.compress_size == 0 or info.file_size / info.compress_size > MAX_RATIO):
137+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"ratio {info.filename}")
138+ if total > MAX_TOTAL or xml_total > MAX_XML_TOTAL:
139+ raise TemplateError("too_big", "declared size")
140+
141+ parts: dict[str, bytes] = {}
142+ total = xml_total = 0

144+ if info.is_dir():
145+ continue
146+ is_xml = is_xml_name(info.filename)
147+ part_cap = MAX_XML_PART if is_xml else MAX_TOTAL
148+ buf = bytearray()
149+ try:
150+ with zf.open(info) as f:
151+ while True:
152+ chunk = f.read(CHUNK)
153+ if not chunk:
154+ break
155+ buf += chunk
156+ total += len(chunk)
157+ if is_xml:
158+ xml_total += len(chunk)
159+ # Declared sizes can lie, so the caps also hold on bytes actually read.
160+ if len(buf) > part_cap or total > MAX_TOTAL or xml_total > MAX_XML_TOTAL:
161+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"actual size {info.filename}")
162+ except TemplateError:
163+ raise

166+ except Exception as e: # BadZipFile (bad CRC, short member), zlib.error, OSError

168+ if info.filename in parts:
169+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", f"duplicate member {info.filename}")
170+ parts[info.filename] = bytes(buf)
171+ return parts

203+class Index:

206+ def __init__(self, parts: dict[str, bytes]):

213+ e.get("Extension", "").lower(): e.get("ContentType", "") for e in ct.iter(q("ct:Default"))
214+ }
215+ self.overrides = {
216+ e.get("PartName", "").lstrip("/").lower(): e.get("ContentType", "") for e in ct.iter(q("ct:Override"))
217+ }
218+ self._rels: dict[str, dict[str, Rel]] = {}

221+ def xml(self, name: str):

233+ def content_type(self, name: str) -> str | None:
234+ ct = self.overrides.get(name.lower())

236+ return ct
237+ base = posixpath.basename(name)
238+ ext = base.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower() if "." in base else "" # '.rels' has extension rels
239+ return self.defaults.get(ext)

241+ def rels(self, source: str) -> dict[str, Rel]:
242+ if source in self._rels:

245+ name = self.find(rels_name(source) if source else "_rels/.rels")

247+ root = self.xml(name)

256+ self._rels[source] = out

278+def check_integrity(parts: dict[str, bytes], idx: Index | None = None) -> list[str]:

280+ idx = idx or Index(parts)
281+ problems: list[str] = []
282+ for name, data in parts.items():
283+ if name == "[Content_Types].xml":
284+ continue
285+ if idx.content_type(name) is None:
286+ problems.append(f"no content type: {name}")
287+ if name.endswith(".rels"):
288+ continue
289+ source = name
290+ rels = idx.rels(source)
291+ for rel in rels.values():

293+ if not uri_ok(rel.target):
294+ problems.append(f"bad external target {rel.target!r} in {name}")

303+ problems.append(f"{attr.split('}')[1]}={value} names no relationship in {name}")
304+ # the package root's relationships (F5)
305+ for rel in idx.rels("").values():
306+ if rel.external:
307+ if not uri_ok(rel.target):
308+ problems.append(f"bad external target {rel.target!r} in _rels/.rels")
309+ elif not idx.find(rel.target):
310+ problems.append(f"missing target {rel.target} from the package root")
311+ # rels files whose source part does not exist
312+ for name in parts:
313+ if name.endswith(".rels"):
314+ src = source_of_rels(name)
315+ if src and not idx.find(src):
316+ problems.append(f"relationships for missing part {src}")
317+ main = idx.main_part()
318+ pres = idx.xml(main)
319+ ids = [e.get("id") for e in pres.iter(q("p:sldId"))]
320+ if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
321+ problems.append("duplicate slide ids")
322+ return problems

324+
325+def load(data: bytes, filename: str) -> Package:
326+ sniff(data, filename)
327+ parts = unzip(data)
328+ idx = Index(parts)
329+ main = idx.main_part()
330+ ct = idx.content_type(main)
331+ if ct == CT_PRES_MACRO or ct not in MAIN_TYPES:
332+ raise TemplateError("not_pptx", f"main content type {ct}")
333+ # Every XML part, by name or by content type, is held to the XML caps and goes through the
334+ # safe parser before python-pptx sees it (F2).
335+ xml_names = [n for n in parts if idx.is_xml(n)]
336+ for name in xml_names:
337+ if len(parts[name]) > MAX_XML_PART:
338+ raise TemplateError("too_big", f"xml part {name}")
339+ if sum(len(parts[n]) for n in xml_names) > MAX_XML_TOTAL:
340+ raise TemplateError("too_big", "xml total")
341+ for name in xml_names:
342+ idx.xml(name)
343+ problems = check_integrity(parts, idx)
344+ if problems:
345+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", "; ".join(problems[:5]))
346+ return Package(parts, MAIN_TYPES[ct], main)

75+ """None when the layout lacks a destination for some need."""

77+ return None
78+ sub = None
79+ if need.subtitle:
80+ if lay.subtitle_idx is not None:
81+ sub = ("subtitle", lay.subtitle_idx)
82+ elif lay.main_body is not None:
83+ sub = ("body", lay.main_body)
84+ else:
85+ return None
86+ bodies: tuple[int, ...] = ()
87+ merged = False
88+ if need.bodies == 1:
89+ if lay.main_body is None:
90+ return None
91+ bodies = (lay.main_body,)
92+ elif need.bodies == 2:
93+ if lay.columns is not None:
94+ bodies = lay.columns
95+ elif lay.main_body is not None:
96+ bodies, merged = (lay.main_body,), True

102+def default_layout(info: TemplateInfo, s: OutlineSlide, deck_has_subtitle: bool) -> str:
103+ """D3 step 4: the class default, then the named fallbacks, then the first compatible."""
104+ order = {
105+ "title": ["title", "content"] + ([] if deck_has_subtitle else ["section"]),
106+ "content": ["content"],
107+ "two": ["two", "content"],
108+ "section": ["section", "title", "content"],
109+ }[s.kind]
110+ need = need_of(s)
111+ for cls in order:
112+ lid = info.default(cls)
113+ if lid and destination(info.layout(lid), need):
114+ return lid
115+ for lay in info.layouts:
116+ if destination(lay, need):

121+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
122+# fit estimate (D5)
123+
124+
125+def is_cjk(ch: str) -> bool:
126+ return unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ("W", "F")
127+
128+
129+def has_cjk(text: str) -> bool:
130+ return any(is_cjk(c) for c in text)
131+
132+
133+def text_lines(text: str, size: int, width: int) -> int:
134+ """Greedy wrap: CJK glyphs one em and breakable anywhere, other characters 0.55 em and
135+ broken at spaces."""
136+ if width <= 0:
137+ return 10**6
138+ tokens: list[float] = []
139+ word = 0.0
140+ for ch in text:
141+ if is_cjk(ch):
142+ if word:
143+ tokens.append(word)
144+ word = 0.0
145+ tokens.append(size)
146+ elif ch == " ":
147+ word += LATIN_EM * size
148+ tokens.append(word)
149+ word = 0.0
150+ else:
151+ word += LATIN_EM * size
152+ if word:
153+ tokens.append(word)
154+ lines, used = 1, 0.0
155+ for w in tokens:
156+ if used + w <= width or used == 0 and w <= width:
157+ used += w
158+ continue
159+ if w > width: # a long word breaks by character, in constant time (Codex round 1, F4)
160+ if used:
161+ lines += 1
162+ k = max(0, math.ceil(w / width) - 1) # full lines before the last part
163+ lines += k
164+ used = w - k * width
165+ continue
166+ lines += 1
167+ used = w
168+ return lines
169+
170+
171+def height(items: tuple[Item, ...], fit: Fit) -> int:
172+ total = 0
173+ for i, it in enumerate(items):
174+ lv: Level = fit.levels[min(it.level, 2) - 1]
175+ n = text_lines(it.text, lv.size, fit.width - lv.margin)
176+ total += (lv.before if i else 0) + n * lv.line + lv.after
177+ return total
178+
179+
180+def groups_of(items: tuple[Item, ...]) -> list[tuple[Item, ...]]:
181+ """Level-1 items with their level-2 children."""
182+ out: list[list[Item]] = []
183+ for it in items:
184+ if it.level == 1 or not out:
185+ out.append([it])
186+ else:
187+ out[-1].append(it)
188+ return [tuple(g) for g in out]
189+
190+
191+def chunk(items: tuple[Item, ...], fit: Fit | None) -> tuple[list[tuple[Item, ...]], bool]:
192+ """Split a body's items between level-1 groups. Returns chunks and whether any single group
193+ alone exceeds the box (a fit warning)."""
194+ chunks: list[list[Item]] = []
195+ cur: list[Item] = []
196+ ngroups = 0
197+ warned = False
198+ for g in groups_of(items):
199+ if fit is not None and height(g, fit) > fit.height:
200+ warned = True
201+ if cur and (ngroups >= MAX_BULLETS or (fit is not None and height(tuple(cur) + g, fit) > fit.height)):
202+ chunks.append(cur)
203+ cur, ngroups = [], 0
204+ cur.extend(g)
205+ ngroups += 1
206+ if cur or not chunks:
207+ chunks.append(cur)
208+ return [tuple(c) for c in chunks], warned
209+

211+def cont_title(title: str) -> str:
212+ return title + ("（續）" if has_cjk(title) else " (cont.)")

218+def plan_deck(info: TemplateInfo, outline: Outline, overrides: dict[int, str] | None = None) -> Plan:
219+ if not outline.slides:
220+ raise OutlineError("no_slides")
221+ overrides = dict(overrides or {})
222+ ids = {lay.id for lay in info.layouts}
223+ warnings: list[Warning] = list(outline.warnings)
224+ for k, v in overrides.items():
225+ if v not in ids:
226+ raise PlanError("unknown_layout", v)
227+ if not (0 <= k < len(outline.slides)):
228+ # its slide is gone: dropped with a warning, no title to name (the page's bridge
229+ # names it when it drops an override itself)
230+ warnings.append(Warning(0, "layout_gone", ""))
231+ deck_has_subtitle = any(s.kind == "title" and s.subtitle for s in outline.slides)
232+ out: list[PlannedSlide] = []
233+ chosen: list[str] = []
234+ compatible: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
235+ for i, s in enumerate(outline.slides):
236+ need = need_of(s)
237+ compatible.append(tuple(lay.id for lay in info.layouts if destination(lay, need)))
238+ lid = overrides.get(i)
239+ dest = destination(info.layout(lid), need) if lid else None
240+ if lid and dest is None:
241+ # the slide no longer fits the layout picked for it: its default, with a warning
242+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "layout_dropped", s.title))
243+ if dest is None:
244+ lid = default_layout(info, s, deck_has_subtitle)
245+ dest = destination(info.layout(lid), need)
246+ lay = info.layout(lid)

249+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "columns_merged", s.title))
250+ if s.kind in ("title", "section"):
251+ status = FITS
252+ if dest.subtitle and dest.subtitle[0] == "body" and s.subtitle:
253+ # the subtitle fills a content body (D3 step 4 fallback or an override): estimate it (F7)
254+ fit = lay.body(dest.subtitle[1]).fit
255+ if fit is None:
256+ status = CHECK
257+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "fit_check", s.title))
258+ elif height(tuple(Item(1, t) for t in s.subtitle), fit) > fit.height:
259+ status = WARNED
260+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "fit_warn", s.title))
261+ out.append(PlannedSlide(i, 0, lid, s.kind, s.title, s.subtitle, (), dest, status))
262+ continue
263+ cols = s.columns
264+ if dest.merged:
265+ cols = (cols[0] + cols[1],)
266+ fits = [lay.body(idx).fit for idx in dest.bodies]
267+ per_col = [chunk(c, f) for c, f in zip(cols, fits)]
268+ n = max(len(chunks) for chunks, _ in per_col)
269+ status = FITS
270+ if n > 1:
271+ status = SPLIT
272+ if any(w for _, w in per_col):
273+ status = WARNED
274+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "fit_warn", s.title))
275+ if any(f is None for f in fits):
276+ status = CHECK
277+ warnings.append(Warning(s.line, "fit_check", s.title))
278+ for part in range(n):
279+ pcols = tuple(chunks[part] if part < len(chunks) else () for chunks, _ in per_col)
280+ title = s.title if part == 0 else cont_title(s.title)
281+ out.append(PlannedSlide(i, part, lid, s.kind, title, (), pcols, dest, status))
282+ if len(out) > MAX_SLIDES:
283+ raise PlanError("too_many_slides", f"over {MAX_SLIDES}")
284+ if len(out) > MAX_SLIDES:
285+ raise PlanError("too_many_slides", f"over {MAX_SLIDES}")
286+ return Plan(
287+ outline=outline,
288+ overrides=tuple(sorted(overrides.items())),
289+ slides=tuple(out),
290+ chosen=tuple(chosen),
291+ compatible=tuple(compatible),
292+ warnings=tuple(warnings),
293+ )

114+def ph_of(sp):

130+def placeholders(tree_root):
131+ """(sp, ph) for each placeholder shape in a slide, layout or master shape tree."""
132+ sptree = tree_root.find(q("p:cSld")).find(q("p:spTree"))
133+ out = []
134+ for sp in sptree:
135+ if sp.tag != q("p:sp"):
136+ continue

159+def xfrm(sp):
160+ if sp is None:
161+ return None
162+ sppr = sp.find(q("p:spPr"))
163+ x = None if sppr is None else sppr.find(q("a:xfrm"))
164+ if x is None:
165+ return None
166+ off, ext = x.find(q("a:off")), x.find(q("a:ext"))
167+ if off is None or ext is None:
168+ return None
169+ return int(off.get("x")), int(off.get("y")), int(ext.get("cx")), int(ext.get("cy"))

180+ """a:lvlNpPr inside an a:lstStyle or p:bodyStyle style container."""

183+ return container.find(q("a:lvl%dpPr" % level))

193+def spacing(ppr, tag: str, size_hpt: int):
194+ """Resolved spacing in EMU from an a:lnSpc / a:spcBef / a:spcAft child, or None when unset.
195+ Percent values are read as a share of single spacing (1.2 em), D5."""
196+ if ppr is None:
197+ return None
198+ el = ppr.find(q("a:" + tag))
199+ if el is None:
200+ return None
201+ pts = el.find(q("a:spcPts"))
202+ if pts is not None:
203+ return int(pts.get("val")) * EMU_PER_PT // 100
204+ pct = el.find(q("a:spcPct"))
205+ if pct is not None:
206+ val = pct.get("val", "100000")
207+ # Transitional files store thousandths of a percent (90000); strict files "90%".
208+ frac = float(val[:-1]) / 100 if val.endswith("%") else int(val) / 100000
209+ return int(size_hpt * EMU_PER_PT / 100 * 1.2 * frac)
210+ return None

213+def resolve_level(chain_pprs, level: int) -> Level:
214+ """First value found walking layout lstStyle, master lstStyle, master txStyles, defaults."""
215+ pprs = [lvl_ppr(c, level) for c in chain_pprs]
216+ size = DEF_SZ
217+ for ppr in pprs:
218+ if ppr is None:
219+ continue
220+ d = ppr.find(q("a:defRPr"))
221+ if d is not None and d.get("sz"):
222+ size = int(d.get("sz"))
223+ break
224+ margin = 0
225+ for ppr in pprs:
226+ if ppr is not None and ppr.get("marL") is not None:
227+ margin = int(ppr.get("marL"))
228+ break
229+ vals = {}
230+ for tag in ("lnSpc", "spcBef", "spcAft"):
231+ vals[tag] = None
232+ for ppr in pprs:
233+ v = spacing(ppr, tag, size)
234+ if v is not None:
235+ vals[tag] = v
236+ break
237+ size_emu = size * EMU_PER_PT // 100
238+ line = vals["lnSpc"] if vals["lnSpc"] is not None else int(size_emu * 1.2)
239+ return Level(size_emu, line, vals["spcBef"] or 0, vals["spcAft"] or 0, max(margin, 0))

242+def measure_body(sp, master_sp, style_chain) -> tuple[Fit | None, str, tuple | None]:
243+ box = xfrm(sp) or xfrm(master_sp)
244+ if box is None:
245+ return None, "no box", None
246+ attrs: dict[str, str] = {}
247+ autofit = None
248+ for bp in (body_pr(sp), body_pr(master_sp)):
249+ if bp is None:
250+ continue
251+ for k, v in bp.attrib.items():
252+ attrs.setdefault(k, v)
253+ if autofit is None:
254+ for child in bp:
255+ if child.tag in (q("a:noAutofit"), q("a:normAutofit"), q("a:spAutoFit")):
256+ autofit = child.tag.split("}")[1]
257+ break
258+ if attrs.get("wrap") == "none":
259+ return None, "wrapping off", box
260+ if attrs.get("vert", "horz") in UNMODELLED_VERT:
261+ return None, "vertical text", box
262+ if int(attrs.get("numCol", "1")) > 1:
263+ return None, "columns in box", box
264+ if autofit == "spAutoFit":
265+ return None, "shape autofit", box
266+ l_ins = int(attrs.get("lIns", DEF_LR_INS))
267+ r_ins = int(attrs.get("rIns", DEF_LR_INS))
268+ t_ins = int(attrs.get("tIns", DEF_TB_INS))
269+ b_ins = int(attrs.get("bIns", DEF_TB_INS))
270+ _, _, cx, cy = box
271+ levels = (resolve_level(style_chain, 1), resolve_level(style_chain, 2))
272+ return Fit(cx - l_ins - r_ins, cy - t_ins - b_ins, levels), "", box

275+def overlap_x(a: Body, b: Body) -> bool:

277+ return True
278+ return not (a.x + a.cx <= b.x or b.x + b.cx <= a.x)

281+def column_pair(bodies: tuple[Body, ...]) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
282+ """The two largest bodies, when they do not overlap horizontally, ordered by x."""
283+ if len(bodies) < 2:
284+ return None
285+ ranked = sorted(bodies, key=lambda b: (-b.area, b.x or 0))
286+ a, b = ranked[0], ranked[1]
287+ if overlap_x(a, b):
288+ return None
289+ left, right = sorted((a, b), key=lambda b_: b_.x)
290+ return left.idx, right.idx

347+ fit, why, box = measure_body(sp, msp, chain)
348+ x, y, cx, cy = box if box else (None, None, None, None)
349+ bodies.append(Body(ph_idx(ph), x, y, cx, cy, fit, why))

352+ main_body = None

373+def open_template(data: bytes, filename: str) -> tuple[TemplateInfo, Package]:

376+ key = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + "|" + filename
377+ hit = _cache.get(key)

385+ except TemplateError:
386+ raise
387+ except Exception as e:

389+ pres_el = prs.part._element
390+ layouts = []
391+ masters = []
392+ for mi, master in enumerate(prs.slide_masters):
393+ masters.append(master._element.find(q("p:cSld")).get("name", "") or "")
394+ for layout in master.slide_layouts:
395+ layouts.append(read_layout(layout, mi, master._element, pres_el))
396+ if not any(lay.title_idx is not None and lay.bodies for lay in layouts):
397+ raise TemplateError("no_text_layout")
398+ defaults = []
399+ for cls in ("title", "content", "two", "section"):
400+ first = next((lay.id for lay in layouts if lay.cls == cls), None)
401+ defaults.append((cls, first))
402+ info = TemplateInfo(
403+ filename=filename,
404+ kind=pkg.kind,
405+ masters=tuple(masters),
406+ layouts=tuple(layouts),
407+ defaults=tuple(defaults),
408+ slide_count=len(prs.slides),
409+ )
410+ _cache.clear()
411+ _cache[key] = (info, pkg)
412+ return info, pkg
413+
414+
415+def read_template(data: bytes, filename: str) -> TemplateInfo:
416+ return open_template(data, filename)[0]

25+def make_parser() -> etree.XMLParser:

27+ # the parser python-pptx uses, so canonical comparisons see the same tree.

29+ resolve_entities=False,
30+ no_network=True,

44+ # expansion attacks arrive, so any DOCTYPE is refused.
45+ raise TemplateError("bad_file", f"doctype in {where}")

1+# Blast radius: d97256c to HEAD
2+
3+## What it does
4+
5+A static page in `docs/` loads Pyodide, python-pptx and `deckfill` from its own origin, then locks the network by adding a second Content Security Policy (`connect-src 'none'; img-src data: blob:; worker-src 'none'`). The user's template, outline and deck stay in the tab: `deckfill.web.Session` reads, plans and fills on the main thread, and the deck leaves as a `blob:` download.
6+
7+The parts the diff does not spell out:
8+- `fill` re-zips every output and puts the template's own bytes back for every kept part whose meaning is unchanged (`src/deckfill/fill.py`, `_restore_kept`). It also writes each slide's own number into copied slide-number fields.
9+- The page reaches Python through a hook on `window` only when the URL hash is `#e2e` (`docs/app.js`, in `loadEngine`).
10+
11+## The one fact it is safe because of
12+
13+After ready, the page makes no request of any kind. Proven at step 4 (ran real code) on HEAD `fc505ff`.
14+
15+`node tests/e2e/c9_privacy.mjs` drives the real page in headless Chromium and saves every browser request and every server hit with times (`qa/e2e/c9-report.json`). The session covers open, ready, two fills with downloads (one with a layout override), reset, 30 s idle, an offline fill and a click on each link-out. `qa/e2e/privacy_proof.py` reads that saved log:
16+
17+```
18+session 33 s; 20 browser requests, 19 server hits
19+before ready: 19 requests, 0 to another origin
20+after ready: 1 browser requests, of which 1 are clicked link-outs (https://mentron.hk/)
21+after ready: 0 page requests, 0 server hits, 0 blocked attempts
22+fills after ready: 2 with downloads, plus one offline
23+PASS: zero page requests after ready
24+```
25+
26+It also fails when it should. The two C9 mutations (a same-origin fetch one second after each download, and outline text in the Gemini link) both fail the session (`qa/failure-demos/c9-*-mutated.txt`). After ready, `fetch` from page JS and from Python (`js.fetch`, `pyodide.http.pyfetch`), same origin and other origin, and new workers (URL, `blob:`, `data:`) are all blocked by the browser.
27+
28+## Risks
29+
30+- **Memory at the input caps.** Spec rev 5 set a bar: wasm heap 1.5 GB or less at the D1b worst case. At the rev 5 caps (100 MB file, 150 MB uncompressed) the worst case reached 1,674 MB, so the seat lowered the uncompressed cap to 130 MB. There it reaches 1,384 MB (99.5 MiB file, 129.5 MiB uncompressed); at the old rev 4 caps it reached 2.39 GB. Wasm memory never shrinks, so a long session with many large templates stays at its high point. HKUST template 14 (73.7 MB) fills within the bars. Check: `node tests/e2e/c12_load.mjs` (bar `worstHeapMB`). Evidence: `qa/e2e/c12-report.json`, `decisions.tsv`.
31+- **GitHub Pages MIME types and headers.** Not proven locally. The page needs `application/wasm` for `pyodide.asm.wasm` and a JavaScript type for `.mjs`. Check at the deploy gate: Fable's real-Chrome run on the Pages URL (root Rule 127). Likelihood low (Pages serves both types), cost high (page never reaches ready, so it fails closed, with no leak).
32+- **Warm load sits on its bar.** The second visit took 5.0 s against 5 s, because the headless test profile's memory cache does not keep the 9.6 MB wasm. A real Chrome profile has a disk cache. Check in real Chrome at the deploy gate.
33+
34+## Cleared
35+
36+- **Subpath.** Pages serves the site at `/ppt-template/`. A scratch server mounted `docs/` there: ready, fill and download all worked, 19 requests all inside `/ppt-template/`, 0 after ready. Every page URL is relative (`new URL("./", location.href)` in `docs/app.js`; `fonts/...` in `docs/style.css`).
37+- **Pyodide's default CDN.** `pyodide.mjs` falls back to jsdelivr when `packageBaseUrl` is unset. `app.js` sets it to the vendor folder, and the static origin check allowlists only that string, with the reason.
38+- **Lazy loads after ready.** All Python modules are imported before the lockdown. A missing module would raise, not fetch. The 2 fills plus 1 offline fill after ready made 0 requests. Each font family is one file, loaded through `document.fonts.load` before ready. User text outside the Noto Serif TC subset falls back to a system font, with no request.
39+- **`_restore_kept` restoring a part the fill meant to change.** Every intended change is excluded by name (the presentation part and its `.rels`, `[Content_Types].xml`, `docProps/app.xml`) or by content type (slide and notes parts). Otherwise it differs in meaning (a layout `.rels` or XML with a hyperlink to a removed slide), so it is not restored. C3 on `sections` checks the hyperlink removal survives. 173 tests pass. The isolated mutation demo is `qa/failure-demos/c3-rels-order-*.txt`.
40+- **The `#e2e` hook.** It exposes the page's own Pyodide to the page's own window. It adds no request (the hash never reaches a server) and no new reader of the user's data.
41+- **Download names.** `file_name` strips Windows-unsafe characters and collapses spaces (`tests/test_web_bridge.py`). Windows reserved device names (`CON`) are left to Chrome's own download-name rules. Unproven, low cost: the user renames the file.
42+- **Other browsers.** The spec targets Chrome and Edge on Windows. Firefox and Safari behaviour of a CSP meta added after load was not tested.
43+
44+## Before you merge
45+
46+- `node tests/e2e/c9_privacy.mjs && .venv/bin/python qa/e2e/privacy_proof.py` on the commit that ships.
47+- `node tests/e2e/c12_load.mjs` for the memory and timing numbers.
48+- At deploy: the Pages URL in real Chrome, ready and one fill, with DevTools Network open after ready.

33+def compressible(size: int, ratio: float) -> bytes:

36+ step = max(2, int(ratio * 0.62))

38+ for i in range(0, size, step):

40+ return bytes(buf)

100+ sample = compressible(4 * MB, 90)

102+ assert r < package.MAX_RATIO, r
103+ margin = 512 * 1024
104+ t_left = package.MAX_TOTAL - margin - total_now
105+ f_left = package.MAX_FILE - margin - size_now
106+ m = max(0, int((t_left - f_left) / (1 - 1 / r)))
107+ f = max(0, t_left - m)

109+ for name in media:
110+ z.writestr(name, compressible(m // n_media, 90))

1+"""C5 validator part: the Open XML SDK (Office 2016) on every output, beside its input.
2+
3+Outputs come from qa/c5/manifest.json: the fixtures it lists, filled here with the reference
4+outline, and every required output of the other QA runs (G0, D10, C10, C1 page, C15). A missing
5+required output fails the run as incomplete, before the SDK is even needed. Each output is validated with its
6+input template, so the report separates errors the fill added from errors the template already
7+had. An output passes when every error it has is on qa/c5/allowlist.json, where each entry names
8+the diagnostic id, the template, why it is harmless and the evidence (spec C5).
9+
10+Needs the SDK at tools/dotnet (gitignored). Build once:
11+ tools/dotnet/dotnet build tools/validate -c Release
12+Run: .venv/bin/python qa/c5/run_validator.py [--manifest <file>]
13+"""
14+
15+from __future__ import annotations
16+
17+import json
18+import subprocess
19+import sys
20+from pathlib import Path
21+
22+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
23+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
24+
25+from deckfill import fill, parse_outline, plan_deck, read_template # noqa: E402
26+
27+OUT = ROOT / "qa" / "c5"
28+DOTNET = ROOT / "tools" / "dotnet" / "dotnet"
29+DLL = ROOT / "tools" / "validate" / "bin" / "Release" / "net10.0" / "validate.dll"
30+FIX = ROOT / "fixtures" / "out"
31+
32+
33+def validate(files: list[Path]) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
34+ run = subprocess.run([str(DOTNET), str(DLL), *map(str, files)], capture_output=True, text=True)
35+ results = {}
36+ for line in run.stdout.splitlines():
37+ rec = json.loads(line)
38+ results[rec["file"]] = rec["errors"]
39+ missing = [f for f in files if str(f) not in results]
40+ if missing:
41+ raise SystemExit(f"validator gave no result for {missing[:3]}; stderr: {run.stderr[-500:]}")
42+ return results
43+
44+
45+def key(e: dict) -> tuple:
46+ return (e["id"], e.get("part"), e.get("path"))
47+
48+
49+def main() -> int:
50+ args = sys.argv[1:]
51+ manifest_path = Path(args[args.index("--manifest") + 1]) if "--manifest" in args else OUT / "manifest.json"
52+ manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
53+ # Every required output must exist before anything is validated (Codex round 1, F13).
54+ required = [(ROOT / r["template"], ROOT / r["output"], r["family"]) for r in manifest["required"]]
55+ missing = [(fam, out) for _, out, fam in required if not out.exists()]
56+ for fam, out in missing:
57+ print(f"MISSING {out.relative_to(ROOT)} ({fam})")
58+ if missing:
59+ print(f"INCOMPLETE: {len(missing)} required outputs missing; run their QA steps first")
60+ return 1
61+ if not DOTNET.exists() or not DLL.exists():
62+ print("NOT RUN: Open XML SDK missing (tools/dotnet) or validator not built (tools/validate/bin)")
63+ return 2
64+ outdir = OUT / "out"
65+ outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
66+ gen = manifest["generated"]
67+ outline = parse_outline((ROOT / gen["outline"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
68+
69+ pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path, str]] = [] # (input template, output deck, family)
70+ for name in gen["templates"]:
71+ src = FIX / name
72+ data = src.read_bytes()
73+ dst = outdir / f"{src.stem}-{src.suffix[1:]}-filled.pptx"
74+ dst.write_bytes(fill(data, name, plan_deck(read_template(data, name), outline)))
75+ pairs.append((src, dst, "fixture"))
76+ pairs += required
77+
78+ allow = json.loads((OUT / "allowlist.json").read_text())
79+ results = validate(sorted({p for src, dst, _ in pairs for p in (src, dst)}))
80+ rows, bad = [], 0
81+ for src, dst, fam in pairs:
82+ before = {key(e) for e in results[str(src)]}
83+ after = results[str(dst)]
84+ added = [e for e in after if key(e) not in before]
85+ unlisted = [e for e in after if not any(a["id"] == e["id"] and a["template"] == src.name for a in allow)]
86+ ok = not unlisted
87+ bad += not ok
88+ rows.append({
89+ "family": fam, "template": str(src.relative_to(ROOT)), "output": str(dst.relative_to(ROOT)),
90+ "errors_in_template": len(before), "errors_in_output": len(after), "added_by_fill": added[:20],
91+ "not_allowlisted": unlisted[:20], "ok": ok,
92+ })
93+ print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", dst.relative_to(ROOT), f"output {len(after)} errors, added {len(added)}, unlisted {len(unlisted)}")
94+ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa"))
95+ from provenance import tested
96+
97+ files = sorted({p for src, dst, _ in pairs for p in (src, dst)})
98+ (OUT / "c5-report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"tested": tested(files), "rows": rows}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
99+ print(f"{len(rows) - bad} passed, {bad} failed")
100+ return 1 if bad else 0
101+
102+
103+if __name__ == "__main__":
104+ sys.exit(main())

1+Reviewed pinned application code and evidence. Application files under src/ and docs/ have identical Git blobs at 884f33a and f6c30a9. Walkthrough artifact is available at f6c30a9:qa/walkthrough/walkthrough.json:1, but absent at 884f33a; its claims were checked against 884f33a. Known cap/heap changes and missing .NET execution excluded. No files changed. Targeted probes ran pinned code in memory; full browser suite was not rerun.
2+
3+F1 | BLOCKER | [diff] | f6c30a9:docs/app.js:232-235,333-337
4+Download can silently omit latest edits. Input schedules replanning 450 ms later while previous plan remains downloadable. Download calls Session.fill() against cached plan (f6c30a9:src/deckfill/web.py:80-81). Pinned-JS probe changed textarea to NEW CONTENT and immediately downloaded OLD CONTENT. Fix: invalidate download synchronously on input and await planning of current outline and overrides before filling. Likelihood: ordinary edit or paste followed by immediate download.
5+
6+F2 | MAJOR | [diff] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/package.py:60-62,92-95,106-120,282-285
7+XML security checks depend on filename extension. A slide-layout XML part renamed to .dat, with relationships and content type updated, bypasses XML-specific caps and DOCTYPE rejection. Pinned-engine probes accepted both an oversized XML layout and a DOCTYPE containing an entity declaration. No entity expansion or disclosure observed. Fix: identify XML through OPC content types as well as relationship filenames, then enforce byte limits and safe parsing before python-pptx opens it. Likelihood: crafted malicious template; uncommon accidental input.
8+
9+F3 | MAJOR | [diff] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/package.py:81-86
10+Member limit runs after central-directory allocation. ZipFile constructs every ZipInfo before code checks the 2,000-member cap. A 47,000,053-byte crafted archive containing 1,000,000 central-directory records eventually raised too_big, but CPython process peak RSS reached 510.4 MiB, versus 162.6 MiB before parsing. This is separate from excluded accepted-input heap changes. Fix: bounded central-directory preflight before ZipFile construction, including actual record count and ZIP64/count inconsistencies. Likelihood: adversarial archive; browser memory impact was not measured.
11+
12+F4 | MAJOR | [diff] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/plan.py:158-164
13+Long-word wrapping can monopolize main thread. Width is subtracted repeatedly from token width; a tiny positive usable box width remains accepted (f6c30a9:src/deckfill/template.py:266-272). With normal 20-point text and 1 EMU usable width, 50 characters required about 7 million iterations. A near-limit outline implies billions; full browser duration was not measured. Fix: calculate line count and remainder with constant-time arithmetic, and test tiny widths. Likelihood: adversarial or damaged placeholder geometry.
14+
15+F5 | MAJOR | [claims] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/package.py:238-266
16+Integrity check misses package-root relationships. It skips _rels/.rels and never validates all relationships from source "". Probe added a root relationship targeting missing.xml; check_integrity returned no problems and read_template accepted it. Fix: validate root targets and external URIs alongside part relationships. Spec L149: "every internal relationship target resolves to a part in the package". Likelihood: damaged or crafted template.
17+
18+F6 | MAJOR | [claims] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/fill.py:73-86
19+Removing sample slides can make otherwise accepted templates unfillable. Generic XML parts, including viewProps.xml, lack _element. Code removes their slide relationships but leaves XML references intact. A saved outline-view reference passed input integrity, then fill raised "bad_file: output failed integrity: id=rId1 names no relationship in ppt/viewProps.xml". Fix: safely parse and update generic XML blobs when removing references. Spec L150: "Any element in a kept part whose relationship points to a removed slide ... is removed together with that relationship." Likelihood: uncommon saved outline-view state. Synthetic case was not SDK-validated.
20+
21+F7 | MAJOR | [claims] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/plan.py:245-247
22+Subtitle-to-body fallback bypasses fit checks. Title slides receive unconditional fits even when subtitle targets a content body. A 4,000-character subtitle overridden onto a content layout produced one slide, fits, and no warning. Fix: estimate subtitle paragraphs when their destination is a body and return warned/check status as appropriate. Spec L165: "For each body, plan_deck estimates the text height". Likelihood: supported fallback or override with long subtitle.

24+F8 | MAJOR | [spec] | f6c30a9:src/deckfill/fill.py:147-160

Spec L155: "Input slides on the same layout: if one carries the type, the new slide gets it, copied from the first such slide". Likelihood: uncommon customized corporate template.

Retry updates displayed prompt but never updates that closure. HTTP errors are also not checked (f6c30a9:docs/app.js:126-129). 40+Validator runner silently omits missing required outputs. G0 decks are discovered by glob; C10 downloads are included only when present. Both are gitignored, so validation can report success without either family. Fix: require explicit artifact manifest, fail incomplete runs, and cover all output families claimed by C5. Spec L217: "reports zero errors on every output". This finding concerns runner behavior, not excluded SDK installation.

1+"""D10: the 匯通物流 demo deck for the reel.
2+
3+The outline is Gemini's answer to the reference report (C15 run, qa/gemini/wui-tung-report.out.txt),
4+filled into fixtures/wui-tung-template.pptx. Writes qa/demo/wui-tung-outline.md,
5+qa/demo/wui-tung-deck.pptx, per-slide renders, a contact sheet and qa/demo/demo-report.json
6+with the C1, C3 and C5 integrity results (C20).
7+
8+Run: .venv/bin/python qa/demo/make_demo.py
9+"""
10+
11+from __future__ import annotations
12+
13+import json
14+import re
15+import sys
16+from pathlib import Path
17+
18+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
19+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
20+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
21+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa" / "g0"))
22+
23+from oracle import kept_part_problems, new_parts, parts_of, read_deck # noqa: E402
24+from run_g0 import actual_sequence, contact_sheet, expected_sequence, render_slides, same_sequence # noqa: E402
25+
26+from deckfill import fill, parse_outline, plan_deck, read_template # noqa: E402
27+from deckfill.package import check_integrity # noqa: E402
28+
29+DEMO = ROOT / "qa" / "demo"
30+
31+
32+def main() -> None:
33+ answer = (ROOT / "qa" / "gemini" / "wui-tung-report.out.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
34+ blocks = re.findall(r"```[^\n]*\n(.*?)```", answer, re.S)
35+ assert len(blocks) == 1, "expected one code block in Gemini's answer"
36+ text = blocks[0]
37+ (DEMO / "wui-tung-outline.md").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
38+
39+ data = (ROOT / "fixtures" / "wui-tung-template.pptx").read_bytes()
40+ info = read_template(data, "wui-tung-template.pptx")
41+ outline = parse_outline(text)
42+ plan = plan_deck(info, outline)
43+ out = fill(data, "wui-tung-template.pptx", plan)
44+ deck_path = DEMO / "wui-tung-deck.pptx"
45+ deck_path.write_bytes(out)
46+
47+ names = {lay.id: lay.name for lay in info.layouts}
48+ rec = {
49+ "slides": [f"{s.title} -> {names[s.layout]} ({s.fit})" for s in plan.slides],
50+ "warnings": [f"{w.line} {w.code}" for w in plan.warnings],
51+ "c1_round_trip": same_sequence(expected_sequence(outline), actual_sequence(read_deck(out))),
52+ "c3_kept_problems": kept_part_problems(data, out),
53+ "c3_unexpected_new_parts": [n for n in new_parts(data, out) if not n.startswith("ppt/slides/")],
54+ "c5_integrity": check_integrity(parts_of(out)),
55+ "c5_validator": "NOT RUN: Open XML SDK not installed",
56+ }
57+ pngs = render_slides(deck_path, DEMO / "renders")
58+ rec["renders"] = [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in pngs]
59+ contact_sheet(pngs, DEMO / "wui-tung-sheet.png", f"wui-tung-deck.pptx: {len(pngs)} slides")
60+ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa"))
61+ from provenance import tested
62+
63+ rec["tested"] = tested([ROOT / "fixtures" / "wui-tung-template.pptx", DEMO / "wui-tung-outline.md", deck_path, *pngs])
64+ (DEMO / "demo-report.json").write_text(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
65+ print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in rec.items() if k != "renders"}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
66+
67+
68+if __name__ == "__main__":
69+ main()

1+# 匯通物流 2027 年度計劃
2+營運部內部簡報
3+
4+## 目標一：本地送貨準時率
5+- 本地送貨準時率由 92% 升到 97%
6+ - 第一季先試行 AI 排程
7+ - 第二季擴展到全部車隊，先做九龍區
8+
9+## 目標二：葵涌倉存貨周轉
10+- 葵涌倉存貨周轉由 45 日減到 35 日
11+ - 會引入新貨架系統
12+
13+## 目標三：大灣區跨境路線
14+- 大灣區新增 3 條跨境路線
15+ - 第三季開深圳、東莞、佛山線
16+ - 第四季檢討成效
17+
18+## 全年預算
19+- 全年預算港幣 800 萬
20+ - 科技 350 萬，佔 44%
21+ - 人手培訓 150 萬，佔 19%
22+ - 車隊 300 萬，佔 37%
23+
24+## 主要風險
25+- 司機人手不足
26+- 跨境清關時間不穩定
27+
28+## 營運部建議
29+- 每月公布準時率
30+- 年中開檢討會
31+- 必要時調整第四季預算

1+"""C10: the page's downloads equal the CPython fill of the same template, outline and plan.
2+
3+Reads qa/e2e/c9-report.json (written by tests/e2e/c9_privacy.mjs), fills the same inputs under
4+CPython and compares every part. Run: .venv/bin/python qa/e2e/c10_compare.py
5+"""
6+
7+import io
8+import json
9+import sys
10+import zipfile
11+from pathlib import Path
12+
13+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
14+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
15+
16+from deckfill import fill, parse_outline, plan_deck, read_template # noqa: E402
17+
18+
19+def parts(data: bytes) -> dict[str, bytes]:
20+ with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
21+ return {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
22+
23+
24+def main() -> int:
25+ report = json.loads((ROOT / "qa" / "e2e" / "c9-report.json").read_text())
26+ outline = parse_outline((ROOT / report["session"]["outline"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
27+ results = []
28+ for f in report["session"]["fills"]:
29+ data = (ROOT / "fixtures" / "out" / f["template"]).read_bytes()
30+ overrides = {f["overrideSource"]: f["override"]} if f.get("override") else None
31+ plan = plan_deck(read_template(data, f["template"]), outline, overrides)
32+ want = parts(fill(data, f["template"], plan))
33+ got = parts(Path(f["file"]).read_bytes())
34+ differ = sorted(n for n in set(want) | set(got) if want.get(n) != got.get(n))
35+ results.append({"template": f["template"], "override": f.get("override"), "parts": len(want), "differ": differ})
36+ print("PASS" if not differ else "FAIL", f["template"], "override" if overrides else "", len(want), "parts", differ[:5])
37+ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa"))
38+ from provenance import tested
39+
40+ files = [ROOT / "fixtures" / "out" / f["template"] for f in report["session"]["fills"]]
41+ files += [Path(f["file"]) for f in report["session"]["fills"]]
42+ out = {"tested": tested(files), "browser_run": report.get("tested", {}).get("commit"), "results": results}
43+ (ROOT / "qa" / "e2e" / "c10-report.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
44+ return 0 if all(not r["differ"] for r in results) else 1
45+
46+
47+if __name__ == "__main__":
48+ sys.exit(main())
