qa/e2e/privacy_proof.py+50 -0
 
1+"""Blast-radius proof of the privacy promise (D6, C9): from the saved whole-session request log,
2+the page made zero requests after ready.
3+
4+Reads qa/e2e/c9-report.json written by tests/e2e/c9_privacy.mjs. Every request the browser saw and
5+every request the server received is in it, with times. After ready the only allowed entries are
6+the user's own clicks on fixed link-out anchors, which the test intercepts and does not follow.
7+Exits 1 on any other entry. Run: .venv/bin/python qa/e2e/privacy_proof.py
8+"""
9+
10+import json
11+import re
12+import sys
13+from pathlib import Path
14+
15+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
16+
17+
18+def main() -> int:
19+ rep = json.loads((ROOT / "qa" / "e2e" / "c9-report.json").read_text())
20+ s = rep["session"]
21+ ready = s["tReady"]
22+ html = (ROOT / "docs" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
23+ anchors = set(re.findall(r'<a\s[^>]*href="(https?://[^"]+)"', html))
24+ norm = lambda u: u.rstrip("/") # noqa: E731
25+ link_outs = {norm(a) for a in anchors}
26+
27+ after = [r for r in s["requests"] if r["t"] > ready]
28+ page_requests = [r for r in after if not (r["type"] == "document" and norm(r["url"]) in link_outs)]
29+ server_after = [r for r in s["serverLog"] if r["t"] > ready]
30+ before_other = [r for r in s["requests"] if r["t"] <= ready and not r["url"].startswith(("http://127.0.0.1", "data:"))]
31+ session_s = (max(r["t"] for r in s["requests"] + s["serverLog"]) - min(r["t"] for r in s["requests"])) / 1000
32+ idle_s = (s["tIdleEnd"] - s["tLastDownload"]) / 1000
33+ tested = rep.get("tested", {})
34+
35+ print(f"tested commit {tested.get('commit', '?')[:12]}{' (dirty)' if tested.get('dirty') else ''}")
36+ print(f"session {session_s:.0f} s; {len(s['requests'])} browser requests, {len(s['serverLog'])} server hits")
37+ print(f"idle after the last download: {idle_s:.1f} s")
38+ print(f"before ready: {s['requestsBeforeReady']} requests, {len(before_other)} to another origin")
39+ print(f"after ready: {len(after)} browser requests, of which {len(after) - len(page_requests)} are clicked link-outs "
40+ f"({', '.join(sorted({r['url'] for r in after if r not in page_requests}))})")
41+ print(f"after ready: {len(page_requests)} page requests, {len(server_after)} server hits, "
42+ f"{len(s.get('violations', []))} blocked attempts")
43+ print(f"fills after ready: {len(s['fills'])} with downloads, plus one offline")
44+ failed = page_requests or server_after or before_other or s.get("violations") or idle_s < 30 or tested.get("dirty")
45+ print("FAIL" if failed else "PASS: zero page requests after ready")
46+ return 1 if failed else 0
47+
48+
49+if __name__ == "__main__":
50+ sys.exit(main())

1+"""Failure demos for the silent-break checks (spec rows C1, C2, C4, C5 integrity part).
2+
3+Each demo applies one isolated mutation to the source, runs the check's tests, restores the
4+file, and runs the tests again. Output: qa/failure-demos/<id>-mutated.txt and <id>-fixed.txt.
5+
6+Run: .venv/bin/python qa/failure-demos/run_demos.py [id ...]
7+"""
8+
9+from __future__ import annotations
10+
11+import os
12+import subprocess
13+import sys
14+from pathlib import Path
15+
16+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
17+OUT = ROOT / "qa" / "failure-demos"
18+
19+DEMOS = {
20+ "c1-text-lost": (
21+ "fill drops the last paragraph of every body",
22+ "src/deckfill/fill.py",
23+ "_put(shapes[idx], paras)",
24+ "_put(shapes[idx], paras[:-1])",
25+ ["tests/test_c1_text.py"],
26+ ),
27+ "c2-column-order": (
28+ "two-column layouts order columns by XML order instead of by x",
29+ "src/deckfill/template.py",
30+ "left, right = sorted((a, b), key=lambda b_: b_.x)",
31+ "left, right = sorted((a, b), key=lambda b_: bodies.index(b_))",
32+ ["tests/test_c2_layouts.py"],
33+ ),
34+ "c4-footers": (
35+ "no footer or slide number is ever added to a new slide",
36+ "src/deckfill/fill.py",
37+ ' """D4 footer rules for one new slide. Returns shape elements to add."""\n out = []',
38+ ' """D4 footer rules for one new slide. Returns shape elements to add."""\n return []\n out = []',
39+ ["tests/test_c4_footers.py"],
40+ ),
41+ "c4-slidenum-text": (
42+ "a copied slide-number field keeps its source slide's cached text",
43+ "src/deckfill/fill.py",
44+ " _number_slidenum_fields(el, number)\n",
45+ "",
46+ ["tests/test_c4_footers.py"],
47+ ),
48+ "c5-integrity": (
49+ "the integrity check stops checking relationship attributes (r:id, r:embed, ...)",
50+ "src/deckfill/package.py",
51+ 'if attr.startswith("{%s}" % R_NS) and value and value not in rels:',
52+ "if False:",
53+ ["tests/test_c3_c6_package.py", "-k", "c5"],
54+ ),
55+ "c9-fetch-after-download": (
56+ "the page fetches a same-origin file one second after each download",
57+ "docs/app.js",
58+ ' $("downloaded").hidden = false;\n}',
59+ ' $("downloaded").hidden = false;\n setTimeout(() => fetch("./copy.js").catch(() => {}), 1000);\n}',
60+ ["node", "tests/e2e/c9_privacy.mjs"],
61+ ),

64+ "docs/app.js",

66+ ' $("download-label").textContent = fmt(COPY.download, { name: p.name });\n'
67+ ' document.querySelector(\'a[href^="https://gemini"]\').href =\n'
68+ ' "https://gemini.google.com/app?q=" + encodeURIComponent($("outline").value.slice(0, 60));',

73+
74+def pytest(args: list[str], tag: str = "") -> str:
75+ if args[0] == "node": # end-to-end check (C9): FAIL lines and the summary
76+ # its own output folder, so a demo run never overwrites the evidence run in qa/e2e
77+ env = {**os.environ, "E2E_OUT": str(OUT / "runs" / tag)}
78+ run = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
79+ lines = (run.stdout + run.stderr).strip().splitlines()
80+ return "\n".join([ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("FAIL")] + lines[-1:]) + "\n"
81+ run = subprocess.run(
82+ [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", *args],
83+ cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
84+ )
85+ lines = (run.stdout + run.stderr).strip().splitlines()
86+ failed = [ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith("FAILED")]
87+ return "\n".join(failed + lines[-1:]) + "\n"
88+
89+
90+def demo(key: str) -> None:
91+ what, rel, old, new, args = DEMOS[key]
92+ path = ROOT / rel
93+ original = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
94+ assert original.count(old) == 1, f"{key}: mutation target not found exactly once in {rel}"
95+ head = f"# {key}: {what}\n# mutation in {rel}: {old!r} -> {new!r}\n# tests: {' '.join(args)}\n"
96+ try:
97+ path.write_text(original.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
98+ (OUT / f"{key}-mutated.txt").write_text(head + pytest(args, f"{key}-mutated"), encoding="utf-8")
99+ finally:
100+ path.write_text(original, encoding="utf-8")
101+ (OUT / f"{key}-fixed.txt").write_text(head + pytest(args, f"{key}-fixed"), encoding="utf-8")
102+
103+
104+if __name__ == "__main__":
105+ for k in sys.argv[1:] or DEMOS:
106+ demo(k)
107+ print(k, "done")

25+## Class picks

27+- EDB (8 masters, Chinese names): title 標題投影片, content 標題及物件, two 兩項物件, section 章節標題. The 8-bullet slide split 6 plus 2 with `（續）`.
28+- elderly.gov.hk (3 masters, 21 layouts): every layout is `other`. Its only layout with a title and a body, `1_Title and Content`, has two bodies that overlap, so it is not `two`. The D3 fallback used it for every slide, the two columns merged into one body with the `columns_merged` warning, and the subtitle became the body's first paragraph.
29+- Microsoft: title `Title Slide`, content `Agenda` (the first title plus one body layout in file order), two `Title and two content`, no section layout. The deck's title slide used `Agenda`, because `Title Slide` has no subtitle box, so the subtitle went into the body. `問答` used `Title Slide` (D3 step 4 section fallback).

31+- HKUST 15: no layout has a `title` or `ctrTitle` placeholder. Its title boxes are body placeholders with a custom prompt, so D3 step 5 refuses it.

33+## elderly.gov.hk: why level 1 is small and level 2 is large
34+
35+This is the template's own styling, not a wrong paragraph level from the fill. Each part is one XML line, so the citations name the element path.
36+
37+- The fill writes the right levels. `ppt/slides/slide2.xml` of the filled deck: level-1 lines are `<a:p>` with no `a:pPr`, so `lvl` is 0; level-2 lines carry `<a:pPr lvl="1"/>` (本地送貨準時率…, then 試行 AI 排程 under `lvl="1"`).
38+- The layout restyles level 1 only. `ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout20.xml` (`1_Title and Content`), the `p:sp` holding `<p:ph idx="10"/>`: `a:lstStyle/a:lvl1pPr marL="0" indent="0"` with `<a:buNone/>` and `<a:defRPr sz="1867">` in grey (`tx1`, lumMod 75000, lumOff 25000). It has no `lvl2pPr`.
39+- Level 2 falls through to the master. `ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster3.xml`, `p:txStyles/p:bodyStyle/a:lvl2pPr`: `<a:buChar char="•"/>` and `<a:defRPr sz="2400">` in `tx1` black. So level 2 is bulleted, black and 24 pt under an 18.67 pt level 1.
40+
41+## Found and fixed during G0
42+
43+python-pptx re-sorts relationships by Id and makes absolute targets relative when it saves. Real templates keep them in another order (EDB, elderly.gov.hk, Microsoft and USC all did), so C3 flagged 3 to 16 changed `.rels` parts per template. `fill` now puts the template's own bytes back for every kept part whose meaning is unchanged. A new fixture, `rels-order`, covers it, and an isolated mutation shows the test failing without the fix (`qa/failure-demos/c3-rels-order-*.txt`).
44+
45+Second fix, from Fable's QA of the renders: a copied slide-number field kept its source slide's cached text, so Quick Look showed 2 on every Microsoft slide and 7 on slide 4. `fill` now writes each slide's own number into the cached text of every `slidenum` field it places. PowerPoint recomputes the field on open either way. C4 checks it on `footer-active`; the mutation demo is `qa/failure-demos/c4-slidenum-text-*.txt`.

1+"""Gate G0: fill real public templates with fixtures/reference-outline.md and judge clean fills.
2+
3+Run: .venv/bin/python qa/g0/run_g0.py [template ...]
4+Defaults to every .pptx/.potx under qa/real-templates/. Writes outputs, per-slide renders
5+(macOS Quick Look) and a contact sheet per template under qa/g0/<name>/, and qa/g0/report.json.
6+"""
7+
8+from __future__ import annotations
9+
10+import io
11+import json
12+import subprocess
13+import sys
14+import time
15+from pathlib import Path
16+
17+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
18+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
19+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
20+
21+from oracle import kept_part_problems, new_parts, parts_of, read_deck # noqa: E402
22+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw # noqa: E402
23+from pptx import Presentation # noqa: E402
24+
25+from deckfill import DeckfillError, fill, parse_outline, plan_deck, read_template # noqa: E402
26+from deckfill.package import check_integrity # noqa: E402
27+
28+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa"))
29+from provenance import tested # noqa: E402
30+
31+OUT = ROOT / "qa" / "g0"
32+REAL = ROOT / "qa" / "real-templates"
33+SUFFIXES = ("（續）", " (cont.)")
34+
35+
36+def expected_sequence(outline):
37+ """What the outline says, in order, as (text, level); titles and subtitles are level 0."""
38+ seq = []
39+ for s in outline.slides:
40+ seq.append((s.title, 0))
41+ seq.extend((t, "sub") for t in s.subtitle)
42+ for col in s.columns:
43+ seq.extend((it.text, it.level) for it in col)
44+ return seq
45+
46+
47+def actual_sequence(deck):
48+ """What the deck holds, in reading order, continuation titles folded back; a subtitle placed in
49+ a body (D3 fallback) reads as level 0 when it follows a title slide's title."""
50+ seq = []
51+ prev_title = None
52+ for s in deck:
53+ title = s.title or ""
54+ cont = any(title.endswith(x) and title[: -len(x)] == prev_title for x in SUFFIXES)
55+ if not cont:
56+ seq.append((title, 0))
57+ prev_title = title
58+ seq.extend((t, 0) for t in s.subtitle if t)
59+ cols = s.bodies
60+ if cont:
61+ # continuation slides carry the rest of each column; fold them back in column order
62+ pass
63+ for col in cols:
64+ seq.extend((text, lvl) for lvl, text in col)
65+ return seq
66+
67+
68+def same_sequence(expected, actual):
69+ """Exact order and text. A subtitle line ("sub") matches level 0 in a subtitle placeholder or
70+ level 1 as the first paragraphs of a body (D3 step 4 fallback when no title layout fits)."""
71+ return len(expected) == len(actual) and all(
72+ et == at and (el == al or (el == "sub" and al in (0, 1)))
73+ for (et, el), (at, al) in zip(expected, actual)
74+ )
75+
76+
77+def render_slides(pptx_path: Path, outdir: Path) -> list[Path]:
78+ """One-slide copies rendered with macOS Quick Look, the way the spike did."""
79+ outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
80+ n = len(Presentation(pptx_path).slides)
81+ pngs = []
82+ for i in range(n):
83+ p = Presentation(pptx_path)
84+ ids = p.slides._sldIdLst
85+ for j, sid in reversed(list(enumerate(list(ids)))):
86+ if j != i:
87+ ids.remove(sid)
88+ one = outdir / f"slide{i + 1:02d}.pptx"
89+ p.save(one)
90+ subprocess.run(["qlmanage", "-t", "-s", "1600", "-o", str(outdir), str(one)], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
91+ png = outdir / f"slide{i + 1:02d}.pptx.png"
92+ if png.exists():
93+ pngs.append(png)
94+ return pngs
95+
96+
97+def contact_sheet(pngs: list[Path], dest: Path, label: str) -> None:
98+ if not pngs:
99+ return
100+ thumbs = [Image.open(p).convert("RGB") for p in pngs]
101+ w = 520
102+ thumbs = [t.resize((w, int(t.height * w / t.width))) for t in thumbs]
103+ h = max(t.height for t in thumbs)
104+ cols = 4
105+ rows = (len(thumbs) + cols - 1) // cols
106+ sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (w + 16) + 16, rows * (h + 40) + 56), "white")
107+ d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
108+ d.text((16, 16), label, fill="black")
109+ for k, t in enumerate(thumbs):
110+ x, y = 16 + (k % cols) * (w + 16), 48 + (k // cols) * (h + 40)
111+ sheet.paste(t, (x, y))
112+ d.rectangle([x - 1, y - 1, x + t.width, y + t.height], outline="#999")
113+ d.text((x, y + t.height + 6), f"slide {k + 1}", fill="black")
114+ sheet.save(dest)
115+
116+
117+def run_one(path: Path, outline_text: str) -> dict:
118+ name = path.stem
119+ work = OUT / name
120+ work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
121+ data = path.read_bytes()
122+ rec: dict = {"template": path.name, "bytes": len(data)}
123+ t = time.time()
124+ try:
125+ info = read_template(data, path.name)
126+ except DeckfillError as e:
127+ rec.update(result="refused", code=e.code, detail=e.detail)
128+ return rec
129+ outline = parse_outline(outline_text)
130+ plan = plan_deck(info, outline)
131+ out = fill(data, path.name, plan)
132+ rec["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t, 2)
133+ out_path = work / f"{name}-filled.pptx"
134+ out_path.write_bytes(out)
135+ rec["layouts"] = [
136+ {"name": lay.name, "master": lay.master, "class": lay.cls, "bodies": len(lay.bodies),
137+ "unmodelled": [b.why_unmodelled for b in lay.bodies if b.fit is None]}
138+ for lay in info.layouts
139+ ]
140+ names = {lay.id: f"{lay.name} [{lay.cls}]" for lay in info.layouts}
141+ rec["defaults"] = {k: (names[v] if v else None) for k, v in info.defaults}
142+ rec["picks"] = [f"{s.title} -> {names[s.layout]} ({s.fit})" for s in plan.slides]
143+ rec["warnings"] = [f"{w.line} {w.code}" for w in plan.warnings]
144+ deck = read_deck(out)
145+ rec["c1_round_trip"] = same_sequence(expected_sequence(outline), actual_sequence(deck))
146+ rec["c3_kept_problems"] = kept_part_problems(data, out)
147+ rec["c3_unexpected_new_parts"] = [n for n in new_parts(data, out) if not n.startswith("ppt/slides/")]
148+ rec["c5_integrity"] = check_integrity(parts_of(out))
149+ rec["c6_empty_placeholders"] = [
150+ (s.n, ptype, idx) for s in deck for ptype, idx, has in s.placeholders
151+ if not has and ptype not in ("sldNum", "ftr", "dt")
152+ ]
153+ rec["text_outside_placeholders"] = [(s.n, s.loose_text) for s in deck if s.loose_text] # F12
154+ pngs = render_slides(out_path, work / "renders")
155+ rec["renders"] = [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in pngs]
156+ sheet = work / f"{name}-sheet.png"
157+ contact_sheet(pngs, sheet, f"{path.name}: {len(pngs)} slides")
158+ rec["sheet"] = str(sheet.relative_to(ROOT))
159+ rec["script_clean"] = (
160+ rec["c1_round_trip"] and not rec["c3_kept_problems"] and not rec["c3_unexpected_new_parts"]
161+ and not rec["c5_integrity"] and not rec["c6_empty_placeholders"] and not rec["text_outside_placeholders"]
162+ )
163+ return rec
164+
165+
166+def main() -> None:
167+ outline_text = (ROOT / "fixtures" / "reference-outline.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
168+ paths = [Path(a) for a in sys.argv[1:]] or sorted(
169+ p for p in REAL.iterdir() if p.suffix.lower() in (".pptx", ".potx")
170+ )
171+ report = [run_one(p, outline_text) for p in paths]

1+"""C15: each Gemini output holds one code block, parses with zero warnings, keeps every number from
2+its notes, and fills wui-tung cleanly. Run after run_c15.sh.
3+
4+Run: .venv/bin/python qa/gemini/check_c15.py
5+"""
6+
7+import json
8+import os
9+import re
10+import sys
11+from pathlib import Path
12+
13+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
14+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
15+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
16+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "qa" / "g0"))
17+
18+from oracle import kept_part_problems, parts_of, read_deck # noqa: E402
19+from run_g0 import actual_sequence, expected_sequence, same_sequence # noqa: E402
20+
21+from deckfill import fill, parse_outline, plan_deck, read_template # noqa: E402
22+from deckfill.package import check_integrity # noqa: E402
23+
24+GEM = Path(os.environ["C15_DIR"]) if os.environ.get("C15_DIR") else ROOT / "qa" / "gemini"
25+CASES = ["wui-tung-report", "english-update", "meeting-summary"] # spec C15: all three are required
26+NOTES = ROOT / "fixtures" / "notes"
27+FENCE = re.compile(r"^(```|~~~)", re.M)
28+NUM = re.compile(r"\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?%?")
29+
30+
31+def numbers(text: str) -> list[str]:
32+ return sorted({n.rstrip(",") for n in NUM.findall(text)})
33+
34+
35+def missing_numbers(notes: str, outline_text: str) -> list[str]:
36+ """Numbers of the notes the outline does not carry, compared as whole tokens: 14 is not kept
37+ by 114 (Codex round 1, F14)."""
38+ have = set(numbers(outline_text))
39+ return [n for n in numbers(notes) if n not in have]
40+
41+
42+def check(name: str) -> dict:
43+ out = (GEM / f"{name}.out.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
44+ notes = (NOTES / f"{name}.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
45+ fences = len(FENCE.findall(out))
46+ blocks = fences // 2
47+ inside = re.findall(r"```[^\n]*\n(.*?)```", out, re.S)
48+ outline_text = inside[0] if inside else out
49+ outline = parse_outline(outline_text)
50+ missing = missing_numbers(notes, outline_text)
51+ data = (ROOT / "fixtures" / "out" / "wui-tung.pptx").read_bytes()
52+ info = read_template(data, "wui-tung.pptx")
53+ plan = plan_deck(info, outline)
54+ deck_bytes = fill(data, "wui-tung.pptx", plan)
55+ (GEM / f"{name}.wui-tung.pptx").write_bytes(deck_bytes)
56+ deck = read_deck(deck_bytes)
57+ rec = {
58+ "notes": name,
59+ "code_blocks": blocks,
60+ "text_outside_block": re.sub(r"```[^\n]*\n.*?```", "", out, flags=re.S).strip(),
61+ "parse_warnings": [f"{w.line} {w.code}" for w in outline.warnings],
62+ "numbers_in_notes": numbers(notes),
63+ "numbers_missing": missing,
64+ "slides": [f"{s.title} ({s.fit})" for s in plan.slides],
65+ "fill_c1": same_sequence(expected_sequence(outline), actual_sequence(deck)),
66+ "fill_c3": kept_part_problems(data, deck_bytes),
67+ "fill_c5": check_integrity(parts_of(deck_bytes)),
68+ }
69+ rec["pass"] = (
70+ blocks == 1 and not rec["parse_warnings"] and not missing and rec["fill_c1"]
71+ and not rec["fill_c3"] and not rec["fill_c5"]
72+ )
73+ return rec
74+
75+
76+def main() -> int:
77+ absent = [n for n in CASES if not (GEM / f"{n}.out.txt").exists()]
78+ report = [check(n) for n in CASES if n not in absent]
79+ (GEM / "c15-report.json").write_text(
80+ json.dumps({"missing_cases": absent, "cases": report}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
81+ )
82+ for n in absent:
83+ print(f"MISSING {n}: no Gemini output")
84+ for r in report:
85+ print(r["notes"], "PASS" if r["pass"] else "FAIL", "blocks", r["code_blocks"], "warn", r["parse_warnings"],
86+ "missing", r["numbers_missing"])
87+ return 1 if absent or not all(r["pass"] for r in report) else 0
88+
89+
90+if __name__ == "__main__":
91+ sys.exit(main())

1+// Static server for docs/ used by the end-to-end checks. Logs every request it receives.

4+import path from "node:path";

6+
7+const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../../docs");
8+const TYPES = {
9+ ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8", ".js": "text/javascript", ".mjs": "text/javascript",
10+ ".css": "text/css", ".json": "application/json", ".wasm": "application/wasm",
11+ ".zip": "application/zip", ".whl": "application/zip", ".woff2": "font/woff2",
12+ ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".png": "image/png", ".ico": "image/x-icon", ".txt": "text/plain",
13+};
14+
15+export function startServer(port = 0) {
16+ const log = [];
17+ const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
18+ const url = new URL(req.url, "http://x");
19+ log.push({ t: Date.now(), method: req.method, path: url.pathname });
20+ if (url.pathname === "/__probe-worker.js") {
21+ // test-only: a worker script that would run if the page's policy let it (C9 probe)
22+ res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript" });
23+ return res.end("postMessage(1);");
24+ }
25+ if (url.pathname === "/__blank") {
26+ res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html" });
27+ return res.end("<!doctype html><title>blank</title>");
28+ }
29+ let file = path.join(ROOT, decodeURIComponent(url.pathname));
30+ if (!file.startsWith(ROOT)) { res.writeHead(403); return res.end(); }
31+ try {
32+ if ((await stat(file)).isDirectory()) file = path.join(file, "index.html");
33+ const body = await readFile(file);
34+ res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": TYPES[path.extname(file)] || "application/octet-stream", "cache-control": "max-age=600" });
35+ res.end(body);
36+ } catch {
37+ res.writeHead(404); res.end("not found");
38+ }
39+ });
40+ return new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(port, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve({ server, log, port: server.address().port })));
41+}

1+"""Test-side readers of an output deck, written apart from deckfill so the checks do not share
2+its code paths: what text sits where (C1), which parts were kept (C3), placeholders (C4, C6)."""
3+
4+from __future__ import annotations
5+
6+import io
7+import posixpath
8+import zipfile
9+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
10+from urllib.parse import unquote
11+
12+from lxml import etree
13+
14+A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"
15+P = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
16+R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
17+PR = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"
18+P14 = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main"
19+RT_SLIDE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
20+RT_LAYOUT = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"
21+RT_MASTER = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideMaster"
22+TITLE = {"title", "ctrTitle"}
23+BODY = {"body", "obj"}
24+FOOTER = {"sldNum", "ftr", "dt"}
25+_PARSER = dict(remove_blank_text=True, resolve_entities=False, no_network=True)
26+
27+
28+def a(tag):
29+ return "{%s}%s" % (A, tag)
30+
31+
32+def p(tag):
33+ return "{%s}%s" % (P, tag)
34+
35+
36+def parts_of(data: bytes) -> dict[str, bytes]:
37+ with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
38+ return {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith("/")}
39+
40+
41+def xml(data: bytes):
42+ return etree.fromstring(data, etree.XMLParser(**_PARSER))
43+
44+
45+def rels_of(parts, name):
46+ d, f = posixpath.split(name)
47+ rn = posixpath.join(d, "_rels", f + ".rels") if name else "_rels/.rels"
48+ out = {}
49+ if rn not in parts:
50+ return out
51+ for e in xml(parts[rn]):
52+ t = e.get("Target")
53+ ext = e.get("TargetMode") == "External"
54+ if not ext:
55+ t = unquote(t)
56+ t = t[1:] if t.startswith("/") else posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(name), t))
57+ out[e.get("Id")] = (e.get("Type"), t, ext)
58+ return out
59+
60+
61+def para_text(pel) -> str:
62+ return "".join((t.text or "") for t in pel.iter(a("t")))
63+
64+
65+def ph_info(sp):
66+ ph = sp.find(p("nvSpPr") + "/" + p("nvPr") + "/" + p("ph"))
67+ if ph is None:
68+ return None
69+ return ph.get("type", "obj"), int(ph.get("idx", "0"))
70+
71+
72+def xfrm_x(sp):
73+ off = sp.find(p("spPr") + "/" + a("xfrm") + "/" + a("off"))
74+ return None if off is None else int(off.get("x"))
75+
76+
77+@dataclass
78+class OutSlide:
79+ n: int
80+ layout: str
81+ layout_name: str
82+ title: str | None = None
83+ subtitle: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
84+ bodies: list[list[tuple[int, str]]] = field(default_factory=list) # left to right
85+ placeholders: list[tuple[str, int, bool]] = field(default_factory=list) # type, idx, has text
86+ footers: dict = field(default_factory=dict) # type -> sp element
87+ run_props: list = field(default_factory=list) # a:rPr elements on runs
88+ loose_text: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) # text in any shape that is not a placeholder (F12)
89+
90+
91+def slide_order(parts) -> list[str]:
92+ main = next(t for (ty, t, _) in rels_of(parts, "").values() if ty.endswith("/officeDocument"))
93+ prels = rels_of(parts, main)
94+ pres = xml(parts[main])
95+ return [prels[s.get("{%s}id" % R)][1] for s in pres.iter(p("sldId"))]
96+
97+
98+def layout_x(parts, layout_name, master_name, ptype, idx):
99+ """x of a placeholder from the layout, else the master's placeholder of the same kind."""
100+ lay = xml(parts[layout_name])
101+ for sp in lay.iter(p("sp")):
102+ info = ph_info(sp)
103+ if info and info[1] == idx and info[0] == ptype:
104+ x = xfrm_x(sp)
105+ if x is not None:
106+ return x
107+ want = "title" if ptype in TITLE else ptype if ptype in FOOTER else "body"
108+ for sp in xml(parts[master_name]).iter(p("sp")):
109+ info = ph_info(sp)
110+ if info:
111+ kind = "title" if info[0] in TITLE else info[0] if info[0] in FOOTER else "body"
112+ if kind == want and xfrm_x(sp) is not None:
113+ return xfrm_x(sp)
114+ return 0
115+
116+
117+def read_deck(data: bytes) -> list[OutSlide]:
118+ parts = parts_of(data)
119+ out = []
120+ for n, name in enumerate(slide_order(parts), 1):
121+ srels = rels_of(parts, name)
122+ layout = next(t for (ty, t, _) in srels.values() if ty == RT_LAYOUT)
123+ master = next(t for (ty, t, _) in rels_of(parts, layout).values() if ty == RT_MASTER)
124+ lname = xml(parts[layout]).find(p("cSld")).get("name", "")
125+ s = OutSlide(n, layout, lname)
126+ root = xml(parts[name])
127+ bodies = []
128+ for sp in root.find(p("cSld")).find(p("spTree")):
129+ info = ph_info(sp) if sp.tag == p("sp") else None
130+ if sp.tag == p("sp"):
131+ for r in sp.iter(a("r")):
132+ rp = r.find(a("rPr"))
133+ s.run_props.append(rp)
134+ if not info:
135+ continue
136+ ptype, idx = info
137+ paras = sp.findall(".//" + a("p"))
138+ has_text = any(para_text(x).strip() for x in paras)
139+ s.placeholders.append((ptype, idx, has_text))
140+ if ptype in FOOTER:
141+ s.footers[ptype] = sp
142+ elif ptype in TITLE:
143+ s.title = "".join(para_text(x) for x in paras)
144+ elif ptype == "subTitle":
145+ s.subtitle = [para_text(x) for x in paras]
146+ elif ptype in BODY:
147+ items = []
148+ for x in paras:
149+ ppr = x.find(a("pPr"))
150+ lvl = int(ppr.get("lvl", "0")) if ppr is not None else 0
151+ items.append((lvl + 1, para_text(x)))
152+ bodies.append((layout_x(parts, layout, master, ptype, idx), idx, items))
153+ s.bodies = [items for _, _, items in sorted(bodies, key=lambda b: (b[0], b[1]))]
154+ s.loose_text = loose_text(root)
155+ out.append(s)
156+ return out
157+
158+
159+def loose_text(slide_root) -> list[str]:
160+ """Every non-empty text run on a slide whose shape is not a placeholder: text boxes, shapes,
161+ tables and anything inside a group (Codex round 1, F12)."""
162+ found = []
163+ for t in slide_root.iter(a("t")):
164+ if not (t.text or "").strip():
165+ continue
166+ el, in_placeholder = t.getparent(), False
167+ while el is not None:
168+ if el.tag == p("sp"):
169+ in_placeholder = ph_info(el) is not None
170+ break
171+ if el.tag == p("graphicFrame"):
172+ break
173+ el = el.getparent()
174+ if not in_placeholder:
175+ found.append(t.text)
176+ return found
177+
178+
179+def deck_lines(deck: list[OutSlide]) -> list[str]:
180+ """The golden-file view of a deck: one line per content item, in order."""
181+ lines = []
182+ for s in deck:
183+ if s.title:
184+ lines.append(f"slide {s.n} title {s.title}")
185+ for t in s.subtitle:
186+ if t:
187+ lines.append(f"slide {s.n} subtitle {t}")
188+ for ci, items in enumerate(s.bodies, 1):
189+ for lvl, text in items:
190+ lines.append(f"slide {s.n} body{ci} L{lvl} {text}")
191+ return lines
192+
193+
194+def read_golden(path) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[str]]:
195+ """Content lines, parser warnings ('warn <line> <code>'), plan warnings ('planwarn ...')."""
196+ content, warns, planwarns = [], [], []
197+ for raw in open(path, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
198+ line = raw.rstrip()
199+ if not line or line.startswith("#!"):
200+ continue
201+ if line.startswith("warn "):
202+ warns.append(line)
203+ elif line.startswith("planwarn "):
204+ planwarns.append(line)
205+ else:
206+ content.append(line)
207+ return content, warns, planwarns
208+
209+
210+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
211+# C3: kept parts
212+
213+
214+def canonical(data: bytes) -> str:
215+ root = xml(data)
216+ return etree.tostring(root, method="c14n2").decode()
217+
218+
219+def reachable(parts, skip_targets=frozenset(), skip_rels=frozenset()):
220+ """Member names reachable from the package root. skip_targets: parts not entered.
221+ skip_rels: (source, rId) pairs not followed."""
222+ seen, stack = set(), [""]
223+ while stack:
224+ src = stack.pop()
225+ for rid, (ty, t, ext) in rels_of(parts, src).items():
226+ if ext or (src, rid) in skip_rels or t in skip_targets or t in seen or t not in parts:
227+ continue
228+ seen.add(t)
229+ stack.append(t)
230+ return seen
231+
232+
233+def removed_slide_links(parts):
234+ """Slides of the input, and every (source, rId) relationship that points at one."""
235+ slides = set(slide_order(parts))
236+ links = set()
237+ for src in reachable(parts) | {""}:
238+ for rid, (ty, t, ext) in rels_of(parts, src).items():
239+ if not ext and t in slides:
240+ links.add((src, rid))
241+ return slides, links
242+
243+
244+def is_rels(name):
245+ return name.endswith(".rels")
246+
247+
248+def content_type(parts, name) -> str:
249+ ct = xml(parts["[Content_Types].xml"])
250+ for e in ct:
251+ if e.get("PartName", "").lstrip("/") == name:
252+ return e.get("ContentType", "")
253+ ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in posixpath.basename(name) else ""
254+ for e in ct:
255+ if (e.get("Extension") or "").lower() == ext:
256+ return e.get("ContentType", "")
257+ return ""
258+
259+
260+def is_xml_part(parts, name) -> bool:
261+ ct = content_type(parts, name)
262+ return name.endswith(".xml") or ct.endswith("+xml") or ct in ("application/xml", "text/xml")
263+
264+
265+def without_links(data: bytes, dead: set) -> str:
266+ """Canonical XML of a part with only the authorised edit made: every element that uses one of
267+ the removed-slide relationships taken out (D4), nothing else."""
268+ root = xml(data)
269+ for el in list(root.iter()):
270+ if any(k.startswith("{%s}" % R) and v in dead for k, v in el.attrib.items()):
271+ el.getparent().remove(el)
272+ return etree.tostring(root, method="c14n2").decode()
273+
274+
275+def rel_set(parts, name, dead=frozenset()):
276+ return {(rid, ty, t, ext) for rid, (ty, t, ext) in rels_of(parts, name).items() if rid not in dead}
277+
278+
279+def kept_part_problems(inp: bytes, out: bytes, allowed_extra_changes=()) -> list[str]:
280+ """Every input part outside D4's allowed changes is in the output: binary parts byte for byte,
281+ XML parts equal after canonicalisation. A part that linked to a removed slide is compared after
282+ taking out only those link elements and relationships (Codex round 1, F11), so any other
283+ change to it still counts."""
284+ ip, op = parts_of(inp), parts_of(out)
285+ slides, links = removed_slide_links(ip)
286+ kept = reachable(ip, skip_targets=slides)
287+ main = next(t for (ty, t, _) in rels_of(ip, "").values() if ty.endswith("/officeDocument"))
288+ allowed = {main, "[Content_Types].xml", "docProps/app.xml"} | set(allowed_extra_changes)
289+ problems = []
290+ for name in sorted(kept):
291+ if name in allowed:
292+ continue
293+ if name not in op:
294+ problems.append(f"missing {name}")
295+ continue
296+ dead = {rid for (src, rid) in links if src == name}
297+ if is_xml_part(ip, name):
298+ if without_links(ip[name], dead) != canonical(op[name]):
299+ problems.append(f"changed {name}")
300+ elif ip[name] != op[name]:
301+ problems.append(f"bytes changed {name}")
302+ # its relationships too, except the ones to removed slides
303+ if rel_set(ip, name, dead) != rel_set(op, name):
304+ problems.append(f"changed relationships of {name}")
305+ return problems
306+
307+
308+def new_parts(inp: bytes, out: bytes) -> list[str]:
309+ ip, op = parts_of(inp), parts_of(out)
310+ return sorted(n for n in op if n not in ip)

123+def _old_text_lines(text, size, width):
124+ """The pre-fix wrap with its one-width-at-a-time loop, kept as the reference for small cases."""
125+ from deckfill.plan import LATIN_EM, is_cjk
126+
127+ tokens, word = [], 0.0
128+ for ch in text:
129+ if is_cjk(ch):
130+ if word:
131+ tokens.append(word)
132+ word = 0.0
133+ tokens.append(size)
134+ elif ch == " ":
135+ word += LATIN_EM * size
136+ tokens.append(word)
137+ word = 0.0
138+ else:
139+ word += LATIN_EM * size
140+ if word:
141+ tokens.append(word)
142+ lines, used = 1, 0.0
143+ for w in tokens:
144+ if used + w <= width or used == 0 and w <= width:
145+ used += w
146+ continue
147+ if w > width:
148+ rest = w
149+ if used:
150+ lines += 1
151+ while rest > width:
152+ rest -= width
153+ lines += 1
154+ used = rest
155+ continue
156+ lines += 1
157+ used = w
158+ return lines
159+

1+# The outline prompt
2+
3+The page's copy button gives you this text. Paste it into Gemini, then paste your notes under it. The Gemini skill in `skill/ppt-outline/` carries the same text.
4+
5+````text
6+Turn the notes I give you into a slide outline for a presentation in a Hong Kong office. The audience is colleagues or managers watching the slides on a projector. A tool will read the outline and fill it into the company's PowerPoint template, so the format below must be exact.
7+
8+Output only the outline, inside one code block, in this format:
9+
10+```
11+# Deck title
12+Subtitle line: team, date or occasion, only if the notes give one
13+
14+## Slide title
15+- Point
16+ - Detail under that point
17+- Point
18+
19+## Slide title for a comparison
20+- Point on the left
21+||
22+- Point on the right
23+
24+## Section title with no points
25+```
26+
27+Rules:
28+- Start with one # line for the title slide. Every other slide starts with ##.
29+- At most 6 points per slide. At most 30 characters per point; a Chinese character counts as one.
30+- Use || only when the slide compares two things side by side, such as two options or before and after.
31+- A ## line with nothing under it makes a section divider slide.
32+- Keep every number, date, amount and name exactly as the notes write it. Add no fact, number or example that is not in the notes. If the notes do not say something, leave it out.
33+- Write in the language of the notes. For Chinese notes, write Traditional Chinese as used in Hong Kong business documents: written Chinese, not spoken Cantonese.
34+- No bold, no italics, no emoji, and no text before or after the code block.
35+````

1+# 用公司 PPT 範本出簡報
2+
3+將你嘅筆記變成一份用公司範本做嘅 PowerPoint。每個標題、每一點都放入範本本身嘅格仔，公司 logo、顏色、字體原封不動，下載之後照樣可以改。
4+
5+網頁：https://marcoaiwithfefe-hub.github.io/ppt-template/
6+
7+## 點用
8+
9+1. 喺網頁撳「複製」，貼落 Gemini，再貼埋你嘅筆記。Gemini 會俾你一段大綱。
10+2. 將公司範本（`.pptx` 或 `.potx`）拖入網頁。
11+3. 貼返段大綱，撳下載。
12+
13+範本同簡報全程留喺你部電腦：網頁載入完之後唔會再連網，熄咗 Wi-Fi 都用得。大綱嗰一步會將筆記交俾 Gemini；唔想交嘅話，可以跟網頁個例子自己打大綱。

21+3. 之後喺 Gemini 打 `/`，揀 ppt-outline，再貼筆記。
22+
23+## 授權
24+
25+MIT，見 `LICENSE`。

55+// Show the working state, let the browser paint it, then run the Python step.

314+ sel.setAttribute("aria-label", `${COPY.layoutLabel}：${s.title}`);
315+ for (const id of src.compatible) {
316+ const opt = document.createElement("option");
317+ opt.value = id;
318+ opt.textContent = layoutName(id);
319+ opt.selected = id === src.chosen;
320+ sel.append(opt);
321+ }
322+ sel.disabled = src.compatible.length < 2;
323+ sel.addEventListener("change", () => {
324+ // remembered by the slide's title, kind and nth, not its index, so it follows the slide
325+ const same = (o) => o.title === src.title && o.kind === src.kind && o.nth === src.nth;
326+ state.overrides = state.overrides.filter((o) => !same(o));
327+ state.overrides.push({ title: src.title, kind: src.kind, nth: src.nth, layout: sel.value });
328+ staleNow();
329+ replan();
330+ });
331+ lay.append(sel);
332+ } else {
333+ const f = document.createElement("span");
334+ f.className = "lay__follows";
335+ f.textContent = layoutName(s.layout);
336+ lay.append(f);
337+ }
338+ const fit = document.createElement("td");
339+ fit.className = "fit" + (s.fit === "fits" ? "" : " is-flag");
340+ fit.textContent = COPY.fit[s.fit] || s.fit;
341+ tr.append(no, title, lay, fit);
342+ body.append(tr);
343+ });
344+ const list = $("warnings-list");
345+ list.replaceChildren();
346+ for (const w of p.warnings) {
347+ const li = document.createElement("li");
348+ const tpl = COPY.warnings[w.code];
349+ li.textContent = tpl ? fmt(tpl, { line: w.line, text: w.text }) : `${w.line} ${w.text}`;
350+ list.append(li);
351+ }
352+ $("warnings").hidden = !p.warnings.length;
353+ $("download-label").textContent = fmt(COPY.download, { name: p.name });
354+ $("download").disabled = false;
355+}
356+
357+async function download() {
358+ if (!state.plan || !state.template) return;
359+ // Read the outline and layouts now; Python plans from exactly these and fills in one call (F1).
360+ const text = $("outline").value;
361+ const overrides = JSON.stringify(state.overrides);
362+ const result = await working(async () => {
363+ let out;
364+ try {
365+ out = state.session.fill(text, overrides);
366+ return { bytes: out.toJs(), name: state.session.fill_name };
367+ } catch (err) {
368+ console.error(err);
369+ return null;
370+ } finally {
371+ if (out) out.destroy();
372+ }
373+ });
374+ if (!result) {
375+ const el = $("outline-error");
376+ el.textContent = COPY.outlineErrors.unknown;
377+ el.hidden = false;
378+ return;
379+ }
380+ const { bytes, name } = result;
381+ const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: PPTX_TYPE }));
382+ const a = document.createElement("a");
383+ a.href = url;
384+ a.download = `${name}.pptx`;
385+ document.body.append(a);
386+ a.click();
387+ a.remove();
388+ setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
389+ $("downloaded").hidden = false;
390+}
391+
392+function reset() {
393+ staleNow();
394+ state.template = null;
395+ state.overrides = [];
396+ state.plan = null;
397+ $("outline").value = "";
398+ $("file").value = "";
399+ $("template-error").hidden = true;
400+ $("outline-error").hidden = true;
401+ $("downloaded").hidden = true;
402+ renderTemplate();
403+ renderPlan();
404+ window.scrollTo({ top: $("step2").offsetTop - 24 });
405+}
406+
407+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
408+function wire() {
409+ const drop = $("drop");
410+ drop.classList.add("is-off");
411+ $("file").addEventListener("change", (e) => readTemplate(e.target.files[0]));
412+ for (const ev of ["dragenter", "dragover"]) {
413+ drop.addEventListener(ev, (e) => {
414+ e.preventDefault();
415+ if (state.ready) drop.classList.add("is-over");
416+ });
417+ }
418+ for (const ev of ["dragleave", "drop"]) drop.addEventListener(ev, () => drop.classList.remove("is-over"));
419+ drop.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
420+ e.preventDefault();
421+ readTemplate(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
422+ });
423+ // a file dropped outside the box must not navigate the tab to it
424+ window.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => e.preventDefault());
425+ window.addEventListener("drop", (e) => e.preventDefault());
426+
427+ $("change-template").addEventListener("click", () => {
428+ staleNow();
429+ state.template = null;
430+ state.overrides = [];
431+ state.plan = null;
432+ $("file").value = "";
433+ renderTemplate();
434+ renderPlan();
435+ $("file").click();
436+ });
437+ $("outline").addEventListener("input", schedulePlan);
438+ $("download").addEventListener("click", download);
439+ $("reset").addEventListener("click", reset);
440+ $("retry").addEventListener("click", boot);
441+
442+ $("copy-prompt").disabled = true;
443+ bindCopy($("copy-prompt"), $("copy-prompt-label"), () => state.promptText);
444+ bindCopy($("copy-link"), null, () => location.href, $("copy-link-done"));
445+}
446+
447+function start() {
448+ applyCopy();
449+ wire();
450+ if (PHONE.matches) {
451+ // The phone view explains and hands over the link; the engine loads if the window widens.
452+ PHONE.addEventListener("change", () => !PHONE.matches && boot(), { once: true });
453+ return;
454+ }
455+ boot();
456+}
457+
458+// Prompt first, then the engine. A prompt that fails to load stops here with the retry state,
459+// and retry runs this same path again (F9).
460+async function boot() {
461+ if (state.loading || state.ready) return;
462+ setStatus("loading");
463+ if (!state.promptText) {
464+ try {
465+ await loadPromptText();
466+ } catch (err) {
467+ console.error(err);
468+ setStatus("failed");
469+ return;
470+ }
471+ }
472+ loadEngine();
473+}
474+
475+start();

1+Turn the notes I give you into a slide outline for a presentation in a Hong Kong office. The audience is colleagues or managers watching the slides on a projector. A tool will read the outline and fill it into the company's PowerPoint template, so the format below must be exact.
2+
3+Output only the outline, inside one code block, in this format:
4+
5+```
6+# Deck title
7+Subtitle line: team, date or occasion, only if the notes give one
8+
9+## Slide title
10+- Point
11+ - Detail under that point
12+- Point
13+
14+## Slide title for a comparison
15+- Point on the left
16+||
17+- Point on the right
18+
19+## Section title with no points
20+```
21+
22+Rules:
23+- Start with one # line for the title slide. Every other slide starts with ##.
24+- At most 6 points per slide. At most 30 characters per point; a Chinese character counts as one.
25+- Use || only when the slide compares two things side by side, such as two options or before and after.
26+- A ## line with nothing under it makes a section divider slide.
27+- Keep every number, date, amount and name exactly as the notes write it. Add no fact, number or example that is not in the notes. If the notes do not say something, leave it out.
28+- Write in the language of the notes. For Chinese notes, write Traditional Chinese as used in Hong Kong business documents: written Chinese, not spoken Cantonese.
29+- No bold, no italics, no emoji, and no text before or after the code block.

1+/* PPT template gift. Look: mentron.hk (site-v3 tokens): ink ground, cobalt action, square
2+ corners, hairline rules, Mentron Serif display, Newsreader and Noto Serif TC body. */
3+
4+@font-face {
5+ font-family: "Mentron Serif";
6+ src: url("fonts/mentron-serif-var.woff2") format("woff2");
7+ font-weight: 100 900;
8+ font-display: block;
9+}
10+@font-face {
11+ font-family: "Newsreader";
12+ src: url("fonts/newsreader-latin.woff2") format("woff2");
13+ font-weight: 200 800;
14+ font-display: block;
15+}
16+@font-face {
17+ font-family: "Noto Serif TC";
18+ src: url("fonts/noto-serif-tc-page.woff2") format("woff2");
19+ font-weight: 200 900;
20+ font-display: block;
21+}
22+
23+:root {
24+ --cobalt: #0252df;
25+ --cobalt-deep: #0140af;
26+ --cobalt-light: #81aeff;
27+ --grey: #e6e8ea;
28+ --ink: #111111;
29+ --ink-2: #1a1a1a;
30+ --white: #ffffff;
31+ --muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
32+ --rule: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
33+ --rule-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
34+
35+ --font-display: "Mentron Serif", "Noto Serif TC", serif;
36+ --font-body: "Newsreader", "Noto Serif TC", serif;
37+ --font-code: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
38+
39+ --max-w: 1120px;
40+ --gutter: 48px;
41+}
42+
43+*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
44+html { color-scheme: dark; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
45+body {
46+ font-family: var(--font-body);
47+ font-size: 18px;
48+ line-height: 1.65;
49+ background: var(--ink);
50+ color: var(--white);
51+ -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
52+ overflow-x: hidden;
53+}
54+a { color: inherit; }
55+button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
56+[hidden] { display: none !important; }
57+*:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt-light); outline-offset: 3px; }
58+
59+/* ---------- bar ---------- */
60+.bar {
61+ width: min(100% - 2 * var(--gutter), var(--max-w) - 2 * var(--gutter)); margin: 0 auto; padding: 22px 0;
62+ display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;
63+ border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
64+}
65+.wordmark {
66+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px;
67+ letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none;
68+}
69+.bar__link {
70+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
71+ color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
72+}
73+.bar__link:hover { color: var(--white); }
74+
75+/* ---------- hero ---------- */
76+main { max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--gutter); }
77+.hero { padding: 88px 0 72px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
78+.eyebrow {
79+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
80+ color: var(--cobalt-light); margin-bottom: 28px;
81+}
82+h1 {
83+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800;
84+ font-size: clamp(44px, 6.4vw, 84px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
85+ margin-bottom: 36px;
86+}
87+.lede { max-width: 40em; font-size: 20px; color: var(--grey); margin-bottom: 18px; }
88+.privacy { max-width: 40em; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); }
89+
90+.status {
91+ margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
92+ display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px;
93+ font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted);
94+}
95+.status__mark {
96+ flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--rule-strong);
97+ transform: translateY(-1px);
98+}
99+.status[data-state="ready"] { color: var(--white); }
100+.status[data-state="ready"] .status__mark { background: var(--cobalt-light); }
101+.status[data-state="failed"] .status__mark { background: var(--white); }
102+
103+/* ---------- steps ---------- */
104+.steps { list-style: none; }
105+.step {
106+ display: grid; grid-template-columns: 148px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 32px;
107+ padding: 64px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
108+}
109+.step__no {
110+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 300; font-size: 88px; line-height: 0.9;
111+ color: var(--cobalt-light); font-variant-numeric: lining-nums;
112+}
113+.step__label {
114+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--muted);
115+ margin-bottom: 6px;
116+}
117+.step h2 {
118+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.25;
119+ margin-bottom: 16px;
120+}
121+.step__body > p { max-width: 38em; }
122+.step h3 {
123+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 12px;
124+}
125+.note { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 14px; max-width: 38em; }
126+
127+/* ---------- controls ---------- */
128+.actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 28px; margin-top: 24px; }
129+.btn {
130+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
131+ background: var(--cobalt); color: var(--white);
132+ border: 2px solid var(--cobalt); padding: 14px 26px;
133+ transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms;
134+ touch-action: manipulation;
135+}
136+.btn:hover { background: var(--cobalt-deep); border-color: var(--cobalt-deep); }
137+.btn:disabled { background: transparent; border-color: var(--rule-strong); color: var(--muted); cursor: default; }
138+.btn--big { font-size: 18px; padding: 18px 32px; }
139+.ghost {
140+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
141+ color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
142+}
143+.ghost:hover { color: var(--white); }
144+.link-btn {
145+ background: none; border: none; padding: 0;
146+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
147+ color: var(--cobalt-light); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px;
148+}
149+.link-btn:hover { color: var(--white); }
150+
151+.fold { margin-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); max-width: 46em; }
152+.fold summary {
153+ cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--grey);
154+ list-style-position: inside;
155+}
156+.fold[open] summary { color: var(--white); }
157+.code {
158+ font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;
159+ background: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--rule);
160+ padding: 18px 20px; margin: 4px 0 18px;
161+ white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; max-height: 340px; overflow: auto;
162+}
163+
164+.drop {
165+ display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
166+ min-height: 168px; padding: 28px 32px; margin-top: 8px;
167+ border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); background: var(--ink-2);
168+ cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms;
169+}
170+.drop input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
171+.drop__main { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; }
172+.drop__sub { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }
173+.drop:hover, .drop.is-over { border-color: var(--cobalt-light); }
174+.drop.is-over { background: #14213a; }
175+.drop:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt-light); outline-offset: 3px; }
176+.drop.is-off { cursor: default; }
177+.drop.is-off:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
178+
179+.message {
180+ margin-top: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; max-width: 46em;
181+ border: 1px solid var(--white); background: var(--ink-2); font-size: 16px;
182+}
183+
184+.layouts { margin-top: 24px; }
185+.layouts__head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px 20px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
186+.layouts__file { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
187+.layouts__head p:not(.layouts__file) { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
188+.layouts__list { max-height: 360px; overflow: auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
189+.master-name {
190+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--muted);
191+ padding: 14px 0 6px;
192+}
193+.layout-row {
194+ display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 7em 4em; gap: 16px;
195+ padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: 16px;
196+}
197+.layout-row__name { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
198+.layout-row__cls { color: var(--grey); }
199+.layout-row__cls.is-other { color: var(--muted); }
200+.layout-row__default { color: var(--cobalt-light); font-size: 14px; }
201+
202+textarea {
203+ width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 18px 20px; resize: vertical;
204+ font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6;
205+ color: var(--white); background: var(--ink-2);
206+ border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0;
207+}
208+textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cobalt-light); }
209+textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
210+textarea:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }
211+
212+.plan { margin-top: 36px; }
213+.slides { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 16px; }
214+.slides td { padding: 10px 12px 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); vertical-align: middle; }
215+.slides tr:first-child td { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
216+.slides .no { width: 5.5em; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
217+.slides .title { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
218+.slides .lay { width: 34%; }
219+.slides .fit { width: 9.5em; color: var(--grey); font-size: 15px; }
220+.slides .fit.is-flag { color: var(--cobalt-light); font-weight: 600; }
221+.slides .cont .title, .slides .cont .no { color: var(--muted); }
222+select {
223+ width: 100%; max-width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px;
224+ font: inherit; font-size: 15px; color: var(--white);
225+ background: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 0;
226+}
227+select:disabled { color: var(--muted); border-color: var(--rule); }
228+.lay__follows { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
229+
230+.warnings { margin-top: 28px; }
231+.warnings ul { list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
232+.warnings li { padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: 15px; color: var(--grey); }
233+
234+/* ---------- working, footer ---------- */
235+.working {
236+ position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 32px; transform: translateX(-50%);
237+ padding: 14px 24px; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink);
238+ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px;
239+ border: 2px solid var(--white);
240+}
241+.foot {
242+ width: min(100% - 2 * var(--gutter), var(--max-w) - 2 * var(--gutter)); margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 0 56px;
243+ font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted);
244+}
245+
246+/* ---------- phone ---------- */
247+.phone-only { display: none; }
248+@media (max-width: 760px) {
249+ :root { --gutter: 16px; }
250+ .desk-only { display: none !important; }
251+ .phone-only { display: block; }
252+ .hero { padding: 48px 0 36px; }
253+ h1 { font-size: 40px; }
254+ .lede { font-size: 18px; }
255+ .phone { padding: 36px 0 48px; }
256+ .phone h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
257+ .phone__steps { margin: 22px 0 28px; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: s; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
258+ .phone__steps li {
259+ counter-increment: s; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.4em minmax(0, 1fr);
260+ padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
261+ }
262+ .phone__steps li::before { content: "0" counter(s); font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--cobalt-light); }
263+ .phone .btn { width: 100%; }
264+}
265+
266+@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

1+Project Atlas weekly update, 24 October 2026 (Customer Service team)
2+
3+Scanner rollout: 14 of 20 branches are live, 70% of the plan. The 6 remaining branches go live by 30 November. Average check-in time fell from 4.5 minutes to 2.8 minutes at live branches.
4+
5+Budget: HK$2.4M approved, HK$1.65M spent so far. Training costs ran HK$120,000 over because two trainers left in September.
6+
7+Old process versus new process: the old paper form needed 3 signatures and took 2 days; the new scanner flow needs 1 approval and takes 20 minutes.
8+
9+Risks: Wi-Fi at the Kwun Tong and Sha Tin branches drops during peak hours; vendor support contract ends 31 December.
10+
11+Next steps: Wi-Fi survey at both branches by 15 November, renew vendor contract, and a staff survey in December.
fixtures/notes/meeting-summary.md+9 -0
 
1+市場部週會紀錄，2026 年 10 月 27 日
2+
3+出席：陳經理、Karen、阿傑、Mandy
4+
5+十月社交媒體廣告開支港幣 38,000，比預算多 6,000，主要因為雙十一預熱提早開始。Instagram 帖文平均觸及 12,400，比九月升 18%；Facebook 平均觸及 5,300，跌 9%。
6+
7+雙十一推廣兩個方案比較：方案 A 主打會員八折，預計成本 25,000；方案 B 主打滿 $500 送禮品，預計成本 18,000。會上傾向方案 B，但要等財務部確認禮品存貨。
8+
9+跟進事項：Karen 星期五前交方案 B 的詳細預算；阿傑聯絡兩間 KOL 報價；Mandy 整理九月同十月數據對比，下次會議再討論。
fixtures/notes/wui-tung-report.md+7 -0
 
1+匯通物流 2027 年度計劃（營運部內部簡報）
2+
3+營運部 2027 年有三個目標。第一，本地送貨準時率由 92% 升到 97%：第一季先試行 AI 排程，第二季擴展到全部車隊，先做九龍區。第二，葵涌倉存貨周轉由 45 日減到 35 日，會引入新貨架系統。第三，大灣區新增 3 條跨境路線，第三季開深圳、東莞、佛山線，第四季檢討成效。
4+
5+全年預算港幣 800 萬：科技 350 萬，佔 44%；人手培訓 150 萬，佔 19%；車隊 300 萬，佔 37%。
6+
7+主要風險有兩個：司機人手不足，以及跨境清關時間不穩定。營運部建議每月公布準時率，並在年中開檢討會，必要時調整第四季預算。

1+---
2+name: ppt-outline
3+description: Turns notes, a report or meeting minutes into a slide outline in the exact plain-text format the PPT template tool reads. Use when making a presentation, slides or a PowerPoint deck from notes, especially for filling a company PowerPoint template.
4+---
5+
6+Turn the notes I give you into a slide outline for a presentation in a Hong Kong office. The audience is colleagues or managers watching the slides on a projector. A tool will read the outline and fill it into the company's PowerPoint template, so the format below must be exact.
7+
8+Output only the outline, inside one code block, in this format:
9+
10+```
11+# Deck title
12+Subtitle line: team, date or occasion, only if the notes give one
13+
14+## Slide title
15+- Point
16+ - Detail under that point
17+- Point
18+
19+## Slide title for a comparison
20+- Point on the left
21+||
22+- Point on the right
23+
24+## Section title with no points
25+```
26+
27+Rules:
28+- Start with one # line for the title slide. Every other slide starts with ##.
29+- At most 6 points per slide. At most 30 characters per point; a Chinese character counts as one.
30+- Use || only when the slide compares two things side by side, such as two options or before and after.
31+- A ## line with nothing under it makes a section divider slide.
32+- Keep every number, date, amount and name exactly as the notes write it. Add no fact, number or example that is not in the notes. If the notes do not say something, leave it out.
33+- Write in the language of the notes. For Chinese notes, write Traditional Chinese as used in Hong Kong business documents: written Chinese, not spoken Cantonese.
34+- No bold, no italics, no emoji, and no text before or after the code block.
